hf.title: SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding
hf.abstract: Perceiving human body motion is critical for multimodal systems that understand and assist people. Yet current evaluations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) largely focus on objects, scenes, and coarse actions, leaving their ability to reason about the body itself poorly assessed. This is especially challenging from the egocentric perspective, in which the body is only partially visible and motion must be inferred from occluded and temporally distributed cues. We introduce SOMA, a benchmark for fine-grained body-motion understanding from egocentric video, comprising 1,632 human-verified questions across three capability axes: body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning. We evaluate 37 leading closed-source, open-source, and specialized egocentric MLLMs, complemented by an extensive human evaluation. We find that humans also find this task difficult from video alone (68.5% accuracy), yet clearly outperform the strongest MLLM (Qwen3.6-27B), which reaches 50.0% zero-shot accuracy. Our error analysis shows that MLLMs often misread the wearer's own body, misjudge events in time, and are prone to biases such as favoring the right hand or under-counting repetitions. To narrow the gap to human performance and support further progress, we introduce a training dataset of aligned video, body motion, and language supervision, and a multimodal baseline that jointly learns from these modalities. By identifying common failure modes and missing capabilities in current MLLMs, we hope SOMA will inspire future research on body-motion understanding and multimodal reasoning. Full benchmark, training data, and code will be released at: https://cnai.epfl.ch/soma
hf.titleZh: SOMA:一个面向细粒度自我中心行为与身体运动理解的基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有MLLM评测多聚焦物体、场景与粗粒度动作，对身体本身运动的理解缺乏考察，从自我中心视角尤为困难——身体仅部分可见，运动线索被遮挡且分布在时间轴上。为此构建SOMA基准，含1632个人工校验问题，覆盖身体构型、运动动力学与时间推理三个能力维度，评测37个闭源、开源及自我中心专用MLLM并配套人类评测:人类仅68.5%准确率，最强模型Qwen3.6-27B零样本为50.0%。错误分析显示模型常误读佩戴者自身身体、错判事件时序，并存在偏好右手、漏计重复次数等偏置;工作同时发布对齐的视频—身体运动—语言监督训练数据与联合学习多模态基线，指向当前MLLM在身体运动理解上的共性失效模式。
hf.reason: MLLM多模态理解评测基准，37模型对比加人类基线，方法扎实

hf.title: HALO: Human-Grounded Granular Evaluation of Proactive Agents
hf.abstract: Proactive agents must decide whether, when, and how far to assist without an explicit request. Existing evaluations often rely on automated scores or binary verdicts, offering limited human diagnosis of evidence use and intervention quality. To address these gaps, we introduce HALO, Human-Grounded GrAnular EvaLuation of PrOactive Agents. HALO-Arena covers 4 proactive need types, Dependency, Blockage, Risk, and Opportunity, across 10 everyday domains and 50 personal environments. Scenarios require agents to retrieve evidence from structured databases or unstructured documents before judging whether assistance is warranted and choosing its scope. On HALO-Arena, we construct HALO-8K, a dataset of 8,000 responses from 10 models across 400 scenarios, annotated by 20 experts for action level, acceptability verdicts, and human diagnosis. For rejected responses, human diagnosis covers timing, intensity, and other issues. Recorded reasoning tokens and retrieval rounds measure the effort behind these responses. The best proprietary and open-source models achieve 72.88% and 56.63% acceptability, respectively. Our central finding is that over-proactivity is the dominant observed failure mode, with Premature timing or Excessive intensity accounting for 61.20% of rejected responses. Further analyses yield complementary findings on the balance between intervention and restraint, evidence acquisition, and the calibration of timing and intensity.
hf.titleZh: HALO:基于人类标注的主动式 Agent 细粒度评测
hf.summaryZh: 针对主动式 Agent「是否需要、何时、以多大幅度介入」缺乏人类可诊断评测的问题，构建 HALO-Arena，覆盖 Dependency、Blockage、Risk、Opportunity 四类主动需求，横跨 10 个日常领域与 50 个个人环境，场景要求先从结构化数据库或非结构化文档检索证据再判定是否协助及其范围。基于 400 个场景采集 10 个模型的 8000 条回复，由 20 位专家标注动作等级、可接受性判定与失败诊断，并记录推理 token 与检索轮次以衡量投入成本。最佳闭源与开源模型可接受率分别为 72.88% 与 56.63%，主要失败模式是过度主动，过早时机或过强强度占被拒回复的 61.20%。
hf.reason: Agent 主动性与评测方法学结合，专家标注细粒度诊断，方向对口

hf.title: On the Origin and Evolution of Training-Inference Mismatch in LLM Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: On-policy reinforcement learning for large language models assumes that training responses are sampled from the current policy. In practice, an inference engine samples the responses and a separate trainer computes the gradients, and the training-inference mismatch between the two makes the training data off-policy. The mismatch has two sources, the numerics of the engine and the stale weights of asynchronous sampling, and a correction that stabilizes training under one source can fail under the other. We ask which property of a mismatch source decides the correction it needs. Evaluating the trainer at the sampler's weights splits each sampled-token error exactly into a numerical discrepancy of the engine and a policy lag of the trainer, and we follow both through training. The numerical discrepancy stays approximately constant, so it biases the updates by a nearly fixed amount, and centering the score at each prefix removes its leading bias. The policy lag is produced by the trainer's own updates: the bias it leaves enters the next update, which enlarges the next lag and closes a feedback loop. Importance weighting cuts this loop only while the lag ratio stays concentrated, and on Qwen3-1.7B it fails at the step where the effective sample size of the ratio falls below one half. From this account we derive the discrepancy-lag correction (DLC), which centers the numerical discrepancy, clips the lag ratio against the sampler's weights and resynchronizes the sampler when this effective sample size falls below one half. Under a stale sampler, DLC keeps the KL divergence from on-policy training within twice the KL between two independent on-policy trainings on Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B, and its resynchronization prevents collapses that the per-token corrections leave and that a KL measured on the sampler's prefixes does not detect.
hf.titleZh: 论LLM强化学习中训练-推理失配的起源与演化
hf.summaryZh: RL训练中由推理引擎采样、独立训练器计算梯度，导致数据off-policy;失配来自引擎数值误差与异步采样的陈旧权重两个源头，同一修正往往只对其中一个有效。以采样器权重评估训练器，可将每个采样token的误差精确拆成数值偏差与策略滞后，并观察到前者近似恒定、可用前缀中心化消除主要偏差，后者经训练器更新形成反馈回路。据此提出DLC:对数值偏差做中心化、对滞后比按采样器权重裁剪，并在滞后比的有效样本量低于一半时重同步采样器。在Qwen3-0.6B与1.7B上，DLC使陈旧采样器下与on-policy训练的KL保持在两次独立on-policy训练间KL的两倍以内，并避免逐token修正遗留的崩溃。
hf.reason: 后训练RL稳定性机制分析与修正方法，直接命中RL训练方向

hf.title: OSWAM: An Effective World Action Model with One-Step Action Generation
hf.abstract: Direct-policy World Action Models (WAM) have demonstrated the benefits of decoupling action generation from explicit future visual prediction for efficient inference in autonomous driving and embodied control. However, they still require tens of denoising steps to achieve competitive action quality, incurring substantial latency and hindering real-time deployment. Simply reducing the number of denoising steps will collapse the nonlinear multi-step denoising trajectory into coarse updates, substantially degrading action quality. To reduce the denoising steps while enabling real-time action generation, we present an effective world action model with one-step action generation, namely OSWAM, for autonomous driving and embodied control. We argue that it is the absence of structured action priors in random noise initialization that forces direct-policy WAMs to recover coherent action sequences through iterative denoising. Hence, we construct imagination tokens to initialize the diffusion process, providing physical priors and action-conditioned representations. We further introduce privileged information distillation with future conditioning to enhance future-aware action generation. As a result, OSWAM can efficiently and effectively generate high quality actions in just one diffusion step. Our experiments demonstrate that OSWAM achieves comparable or even better results in both autonomous driving and embodied control than direct-policy WAM and Joint-WAM that require tens of steps. It obtains approximately 3times speedup over direct-policy WAM baselines and supports real-time compiled inference with latency as low as 40ms on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU. The project page is available at https://gwenzhang.github.io/OSWAM/
hf.titleZh: OSWAM:一种高效的单步动作生成世界动作模型
hf.summaryZh: 直接策略世界动作模型(WAM)虽把动作生成与显式未来视觉预测解耦以获得高效推理，却仍需数十步去噪，带来显著延迟、难以实时部署;而简单削减去噪步数会把多步非线性去噪轨迹压缩成粗糙更新，明显损害动作质量。该工作认为症结在于随机噪声初始化缺乏结构化动作先验，于是构造 imagination tokens 初始化扩散过程，提供物理先验与动作条件表示，并引入带未来条件的特权信息蒸馏来增强未来感知的动作生成，使模型仅用一步扩散即可产出高质量动作。在自动驾驶与具身控制任务上，其效果与需数十步的直接策略 WAM 及 Joint-WAM 相当甚至更优，相对直接策略基线约 3 倍加速，在 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上编译推理延迟低至 40ms。
hf.reason: 面向具身控制与自动驾驶的动作扩散生成，落在机器人低分方向

hf.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
hf.abstract: Recent work shows that a frozen robot policy performs far better inside an agent harness, where control code decides when to query the policy, consult vision tools, or command the arm directly. Yet today these harnesses are built by hand and redesigned for each new robot or benchmark. We show that harness design can be automated, offering a strong alternative to finetuning on a novel setup. In RoboArchitect, a coding model observes a robot's rollouts, diagnoses failures, and iteratively revises the harness around the frozen policy. The harness evolves on a set of episodes for its optimization and is evaluated on held-out scenes and tasks. Without updating any model weights, RoboArchitect raises average success from 9.7% to 43.3% on unseen scenes (4.5x) and from 12.7% to 40.2% on unseen tasks (3.2x), across multiple benchmarks and policies. The gains are largest where the benchmark is far from the policy's training data: wrapping a general-purpose policy, the evolved harness yields a specialist that often outperforms even the finetuned version. Intuitive control strategies are automatically designed, such as lifting a jammed arm clear or reaching in horizontally when an obstacle blocks the way from above. The harness also evolves its own persistent memory, carrying learned experience, such as effective grasp depths, into later decisions. These results suggest that substantial headroom in robotic manipulation lies in the agent harness, and its design can be effectively automated and optimized without weight updates.
hf.titleZh: RoboArchitect：以持久记忆自动化设计机器人智能体
hf.summaryZh: 机器人策略通常需要在手工搭建的智能体harness中运行才能发挥性能，而每个新机器人或新benchmark都要重新设计harness。RoboArchitect让编码模型观察冻结策略的 rollout、诊断失败原因，并迭代改写harness中的控制代码，同时让harness演化出持久记忆以携带抓取深度等经验。在不更新任何模型权重的情况下，未见场景平均成功率由9.7%升至43.3%（4.5倍），未见任务由12.7%升至40.2%（3.2倍）；当benchmark与策略训练数据差距较大时增益最大，演化出的harness甚至可超过微调版本。
hf.reason: 机器人操作harness自动化，属具身智能应用，仅与Agent方向擦边

hf.title: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
hf.abstract: An effective agent memory system should adapt to a user's history and task requirements. Human-annotated supervision can guide this adaptation by providing feedback for evaluating and improving memory designs. Yet suitable labels are rarely available for new user histories, and manually constructing QA pairs and supporting evidence is costly. We introduce MemSteer, which turns unlabeled user histories into question-answer (QA) supervision with supporting evidence for memory-design optimization. MemSteer constructs an evidence-grounded answer plan that specifies how facts across related records jointly support a reference answer. The plan guides question generation, while source-grounded auditing and blind answer recovery check the resulting annotations. To study the utility of this supervision, we develop MemSteer-Opt, which combines QA-based design evaluation with evidence-guided failure diagnosis to revise memory store, retrieval, and context construction without updating model parameters. Experiments on ATM-Bench and RHELM show that this supervision is competitive with official-QA-guided optimization. Relative to Base-BM25, MemSteer-Opt improves ATM-Bench Question Score by 13.4 points and RHELM accuracy by 4.1 and 6.6 points without and with external data, respectively. The supervision also benefits two existing optimizers on ATM-Bench, while new-user experiments demonstrate continued design optimization using supervision generated from the target histories.
hf.titleZh: MemSteer：将用户历史转化为监督信号以优化Agent记忆
hf.summaryZh: Agent记忆系统的设计优化缺少标注监督，而人工构造QA与支撑证据成本高昂。MemSteer从无标注用户历史中构造证据锚定的答案计划，明确跨相关记录的事实如何共同支撑参考答案，据此生成问题，并通过溯源审计与盲答恢复校验标注质量；配套的MemSteer-Opt在不更新模型参数的前提下，以QA评估结合证据引导的失败诊断，改写记忆存储、检索与上下文构建。在ATM-Bench上Question Score较Base-BM25提升13.4分，RHELM准确率在无／有外部数据下分别提升4.1与6.6分，且该监督可迁移增益两个已有优化器。工作给出了一条低成本、可复用的记忆系统自动优化路径，适用于个性化Agent与长期交互场景。
hf.reason: Agent记忆优化与监督数据合成，命中Agent方向且系统性较强

hf.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
hf.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and τ-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.
hf.titleZh: GEPA-Curator：面向自我改进智能体的精选学习
hf.summaryZh: 多轮Agent任务中，GEPA等反思式提示优化器从失败轨迹学习，但失败也可能来自提示弱点、harness限制、随机执行或噪声评审，这类信号可能无益甚至有害。GEPA-Curator通过两个组件筛选学习经验:任务精选过滤可能产生噪声或不可靠信号的任务，先验成功检索则取回历史成功轨迹作为提示优化器的额外上下文。在GoBrowse、ALFWorld、AppWorld和τ-bench上，以Gemini 3.1 Pro与Claude Opus 5作为优化器模型，该方法持平或超过基线，相对GEPA最高提升20.7%，相对ACE最高提升21.2%。该工作为Agentic自我改进中的经验筛选与复用提供了可落地机制。
hf.reason: Agent提示优化与经验精选，属Agent自我改进方向，结果扎实

hf.title: Supervising the Visible State: Separating Representation from View Selection in Streaming Video
hf.abstract: An action seen once and the same action seen three times receive the same action-recognition label, so that supervision does not require a model to count. Answers shared across histories that differ in event order, accumulation, or relations leave those distinctions unconstrained; we call this state under-specification. Visible-State Supervision (ViSS) addresses it by training on source-grounded probes of event identity, order, accumulation, relation change, and answer sufficiency; under the same recent-frame interface it improves OVO-Bench over a strict-matched generic temporal supervision baseline while remaining comparable on StreamingBench, with the largest gain in hallucination detection. Test-Time Causal View Search (TVS) then adapts evidence access while keeping the learned model fixed, expanding from recent frames to sparse event and compact history views on demand. The two interventions separate representation from view selection: supervision particularly benefits hallucination detection and causal reasoning, access particularly benefits event recall and forward reasoning. Together they reach the best reported accuracy among the published systems compared here on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench at a fraction of the processed frames of exhaustive selection, and strict replay shows that most of the remaining gap to a three-view oracle is a correct answer that was later replaced. Streaming accuracy depends on what supervision asks the model to keep, what evidence inference exposes, and whether the model keeps a correct answer once it has one.
hf.titleZh: 监督可见状态：在流式视频中分离表征与视图选择
hf.summaryZh: 流式视频中同一动作无论出现一次还是三次都得到相同标签，不同事件顺序与累积关系因此未被约束，形成状态欠定。可见状态监督（ViSS）用事件身份、顺序、累积、关系变化与答案充分性的基于源数据探针训练模型；测试时因果视图搜索（TVS）在模型固定下按需从近期帧扩展到稀疏事件与紧凑历史视图。ViSS在OVO-Bench超过严格匹配的通用时序监督基线，幻觉检测增益最大，StreamingBench相当；TVS提升事件召回与前向推理，二者以远少于穷举选择的帧数取得对比系统中最佳准确率，剩余与三视图oracle的差距多为正确答案被后续替换。
hf.reason: 流式视频理解与测试时证据选择，属多模态理解擦边

hf.title: No Channels Left Behind: Understanding Diffusion Acceleration through Residual Gates
hf.abstract: Training acceleration methods for diffusion transformers, such as REPA and dispersive regularization, are commonly explained by additional supervision, spatial-structure priors, or improved feature geometry. We revisit this view and uncover a striking internal change: the AdaLN-Zero residual gate α, which directly controls how conditioned updates enter the residual stream, is substantially reorganized by these methods. This observation motivates our hypothesis that acceleration arises, at least in part, from reshaping the residual gating pathway rather than solely from the feature structures explicitly imposed by auxiliary objectives. Supporting this view, accelerated models are markedly more sensitive to perturbations of α, and their gate geometry reflects semantic relationships among classes. We further introduce the normalized participation ratio (nPR) to characterize the channel-wise organization of the gates and find that, across REPA teachers, projector architectures, and radial-objective targets, broader gate participation accompanies better generation quality. Guided by this insight, we propose a simple teacher-free radial objective that promotes broader gate participation through feature-norm regularization, without pairwise feature comparisons. On ImageNet 256times256 with SiT-B/2, our method improves FID over dispersive loss while increasing mean gate participation over timesteps and classes, further supporting the link between gate organization and training acceleration. Our results identify residual-gate reorganization as a measurable axis of diffusion training acceleration and suggest a simple direction for further acceleration.
hf.titleZh: 不落下任何通道:通过残差门控理解扩散加速
hf.summaryZh: 扩散 Transformer 的训练加速方法(如 REPA 与 dispersive 正则)通常被归因于额外监督、空间结构先验或特征几何改善;本文重新审视这一解释，发现这些方法会显著重组 AdaLN-Zero 的残差门控 α，即控制条件更新如何进入残差流的通道门。加速后的模型对 α 扰动更敏感，门控几何还反映类别间的语义关系;为此提出归一化参与率(nPR)刻画门控的通道级组织，并在不同 REPA 教师、投影器架构与径向目标下观察到门控参与越广、生成质量越好。据此设计了一个无需教师的径向目标，通过特征范数正则拓宽门控参与、避免成对特征比较;在 ImageNet 256×256 上以 SiT-B/2 取得优于 dispersive loss 的 FID，同时提升跨时间步与类别的平均门控参与度。
hf.reason: 扩散 Transformer 训练加速，属扩散模型低分方向

hf.title: Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report
hf.abstract: Metis is a bet that better data, better training methods and new architectures can buy what a bigger parameter count cannot, at a fraction of the cost. Metis-1.6 is its latest step: two language models built from scratch by a single researcher, Praxis (2.94B parameters, 0.46B active per pass) and Logos (10.23B parameters, 1.18B active per pass). Both run a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention mixture-of-experts stack twice for every token, so each token gets a second look. Each was trained on 1.02T tokens in total: 804.76B of pretraining, 18B of context extension to 131,072 tokens, and 200B of supervised fine-tuning. Metis-1.6 was never meant to challenge frontier models, and across 40 post-trained benchmarks it mostly does not: Logos averages 52.93, seventh of 17 models in its comparison set and within a point of Qwen3-4B. But it gets there on roughly a twelfth of the median training data of the comparators that disclose it, and with fewer active parameters per token than any model that beats it, which puts it on the Pareto frontier for both. In mathematics it ranks second of 30 models, with 67.50% on AIME 2025 and 63.64% on HMMT February 2026. It is weak at code, instruction following and long context. The rest of the report is the part I found most valuable: what went wrong. The optimizer I configured never ran, and attention trained with AdamW for all of pretraining. A 1.77B-parameter n-gram memory learned to switch itself off. Five fine-tuning choices cost capability. And a length reward under group-mean normalization punished correct solutions for being long once a group's pass rate passed 2/3, a sign inversion I prove and fix with a one-line clamp. I close with the 10B-token ablations behind MoRE (Mixture of Recursive Experts), the looped architecture of Metis-1.7.
hf.titleZh: Think Twice：Metis-1.6 技术报告
hf.summaryZh: 单人从零训练的两个 MoE 模型 Praxis（2.94B 总参 / 0.46B 激活）与 Logos（10.23B / 1.18B），采用 Mamba-2 与注意力混合的 MoE 堆栈，并对每个 token 重复计算两遍，共训 1.02T token（预训练 804.76B、长上下文 18B、SFT 200B）。40 个后训练基准上 Logos 平均 52.93、居 17 个模型第七，与 Qwen3-4B 相差不足 1 分，而训练数据约为披露该数据同类中位数的 1/12、激活参数更少，处于帕累托前沿；数学较强（AIME 2025 67.50%、HMMT 2026 年 2 月 63.64%），代码与长上下文偏弱。报告主体是失败复盘：优化器配置从未生效、注意力全程用 AdamW、n-gram 记忆自我关闭、五项微调选择损失能力，以及组均值归一下长度奖励的符号翻转（附证明与一行 clamp 修复），末段给出支撑 MoRE 循环架构的 10B token 消融。
hf.reason: 混合 Mamba-2 的循环 MoE 架构＋扎实失败复盘，正中架构与后训练方向

hf.title: VoxLock: Target-Speaker Extraction for Voice Agents Without an Enrollment Step
hf.abstract: A voice agent's speech recognizer transcribes everyone near the microphone, including people other than the caller. I fine-tuned a public causal target-speaker extraction model (REAL-TSE, 27M parameters) on one GPU to work from a voice sample cut from the call itself, and released it as VoxLock. I score it by what a recognizer writes on real recordings. On Krisp's 265-recording benchmark it reaches 4.95% WER against 23.21% unprocessed and lets 9 background words into the transcript over 85 minutes of background-only speech. Its WER is not significantly different from Krisp's best filters and is significantly lower than the other commercial and open systems I tested. On 400 AMI meeting windows built and frozen before scoring, it cuts WER from 42.95% to 10.63%. The 8-bit model runs a live call on 77% of one CPU thread with 24 ms of algorithmic latency. Model, code and per-file scores are open.
hf.titleZh: VoxLock：无需注册步骤的语音智能体目标说话人提取
hf.summaryZh: 语音智能体的识别器会把麦克风附近所有人都转写进来，而非仅限来电者。作者在单张 GPU 上微调公开的因果目标说话人提取模型 REAL-TSE（27M 参数），使其直接从通话本身截取的语音片段作为参考，无需单独注册环节，并以真实录音上识别器的输出作为评价指标。在 Krisp 265 条录音基准上，词错率从 23.21% 降至 4.95%，85 分钟纯背景语音中仅 9 个背景词进入转写；在预先冻结的 400 个 AMI 会议窗口上，词错率由 42.95% 降至 10.63%。8 位量化模型在单个 CPU 线程 77% 占用下实时运行，算法延迟 24ms，模型、代码与逐文件得分均已开源。
hf.reason: 语音前端目标说话人提取，属语音应用低分方向

hf.title: TernScope: Model-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient Ternary Endoscopic Segmentation
hf.abstract: Edge medical segmentation must reconcile small model size, high accuracy, and fast inference. TernScope addresses this tradeoff through model--hardware co-design, learning a compact segmentation network whose low-bit operators also simplify hardware execution. Split-channel large-kernel blocks preserve spatial context with limited computation, while branch fusion removes redundant inference paths. Ternary Progressive Quantization-aware Training (TPQ) then adapts the fused network from deep to shallow layers, through the decoder, and finally to the input and prediction layers. All 25 convolutions use ternary weights and 8-bit activations, enabling packed storage and multiplier-free computation. The resulting model uses 0.2483 M parameters and 0.0949 GMACs while retaining competitive segmentation accuracy on in-domain and external datasets. Under the same 45 nm technology, TernScope reduces compute-array area by 88.46% compared with the original Gemmini, a systolic-array accelerator with 8-bit times 8-bit multipliers. These results demonstrate a path from accurate lightweight medical segmentation to compact low-bit hardware.
hf.titleZh: TernScope：用于高效三元内窥镜分割的模型—硬件协同设计
hf.summaryZh: 面向内窥镜图像分割在模型体积、精度与推理速度之间的权衡，采用模型—硬件协同设计：以分裂通道大核卷积块在有限计算量下保留空间上下文，并通过分支融合去除冗余推理路径；三值渐进量化感知训练（TPQ）按由深到浅、经解码器再到输入与预测层的顺序逐段适配。全部25个卷积使用三值权重与8位激活，支持打包存储与无乘法器计算，模型仅0.2483M参数、0.0949 GMACs，在域内与外部数据集上保持有竞争力的分割精度；在相同45nm工艺下，相比采用8位乘8位乘法器的Gemmini脉动阵列加速器，计算阵列面积减少88.46%。该工作给出了从轻量医疗分割模型通向紧凑低位硬件的可行路径。
hf.reason: 医疗影像分割与低位硬件协同设计，属低分方向，仅与效率量化略沾边

arxiv.title: From Natural Language to Exact Cover: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Zebra Puzzles
arxiv.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation has substantially improved the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on complex reasoning tasks, including code generation, data analysis, and exam-style question answering. Despite these advances, purely neural LLMs continue to struggle with elementary logical reasoning problems and lack the determinism, soundness, and reliability characteristic of symbolic reasoning systems. Conversely, classical symbolic methods such as SAT solving and exact cover guarantee correctness and completeness, but require problems to be expressed in highly specialized formal encodings, limiting their applicability to natural language inputs. In this work, we present a synergistic neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by combining neural semantic parsing with deterministic exact cover reasoning. Given a Zebra-style logic puzzle in natural language, an LLM translates entities and constraints into structured tool calls that construct an exact cover instance. A symbolic solver then computes the solution and provides feedback to iteratively refine invalid, under- or overconstrained encodings, exploiting the uniqueness property of Zebra puzzles. We conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation across multiple parameter scales, post-training paradigms, and LLM families. The results demonstrate that our hybrid approach consistently outperforms strong plain neural baselines, including CoT prompting, as well as recent neuro-symbolic methods.
arxiv.titleZh: 从自然语言到精确覆盖:一种求解斑马谜题的神经符号方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 纯神经 LLM 在基础逻辑推理上仍缺乏确定性与可靠性，而 SAT、精确覆盖等符号方法虽能保证正确完备，却要求专门的形式化编码。该工作让 LLM 充当语义解析器，把自然语言斑马谜题的实体与约束翻译为结构化工具调用，构建精确覆盖实例，再由符号求解器求解，并利用斑马谜题解唯一性把编码非法、约束不足或过约束的反馈回传给 LLM 迭代修正。在多个参数规模、后训练范式与模型家族上的实验显示，该混合流程稳定优于 CoT 等纯神经基线以及近期神经符号方法。
arxiv.reason: LLM 与符号求解器结合的推理管道，方法清晰但限于谜题任务

arxiv.title: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
arxiv.abstract: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. The resulting suite comprises 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows, where existing works often fail to cover. Beyond reliable evaluation, WebHarbor provides high-fidelity synthetic web environments for cost-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). We demonstrate that a Qwen 4B-level GUI agent trained with RL in WebHarbor generalizes to unseen tasks and performs competitively with leading open-source GUI web agents across four benchmarks. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor.
arxiv.titleZh: WebHarbor：对接真实网站、构建可演化的GUI Agent环境
arxiv.summaryZh: GUI web agent 需要稳定可交互的环境进行评测与训练，但线上真实网站存在内容变动、访问受限、登录后流程覆盖不足的问题，已有合成环境又缺乏功能深度与视觉保真度。WebHarbor 通过任务驱动的人机协作构建了153个可执行、Docker化的网站环境，复刻真实服务的界面、内容与功能工作流，并让环境随新任务不断扩展功能：coding agent 实现改动，人工审核视觉保真、功能正确性与任务有效性，最终形成涵盖多步与登录后流程的3518个任务。在训练侧，Qwen 4B 级 GUI agent 经 WebHarbor 的RL训练后可泛化到未见任务，在四个benchmark上与领先开源GUI web agent表现相当。该工作为GUI agent提供了可复现、低成本、可演化的评测与强化学习环境底座。
arxiv.reason: GUI Agent 环境合成与Agentic RL闭环，系统性强、规模扎实

arxiv.title: Pretraining Data Scale Reverses the Muon-AdamW Fine-Tuning Gap
arxiv.abstract: Muon has recently emerged as a promising optimizer for pretraining large language models, offering a speedup over AdamW in minimizing pretraining loss. However, it remains unclear whether Muon's advantage persists after fine-tuning. In this paper, we study the downstream behavior of Muon and AdamW and uncover a surprising trend: beyond a sufficiently large pretraining data budget, AdamW outperforms Muon after fine-tuning. Moreover, as model size increases, AdamW overtakes Muon at progressively smaller pretraining token-parameter ratios. To explain this reversal, we view fine-tuning as a perturbation of the outputs and introduce the margin-to-spread ratio, which measures how far the correct logit lies above the wrong ones relative to how widely the wrong logits are spread. In language models, Muon has the larger margin-to-spread ratio at small data budgets and AdamW at large ones, mirroring the fine-tuning trend. In a linear associative memory, we prove that after one update the margin-to-spread ratio of gradient descent gains on that of Muon as the data budget grows, and simulations show that this trend persists after extended training.
arxiv.titleZh: 预训练数据规模逆转了Muon与AdamW的微调差距
arxiv.summaryZh: Muon在预训练损失上快于AdamW，但其优势能否延续到微调阶段尚不清楚。该工作系统比较两者微调后的下游表现，发现预训练数据预算超过一定规模后AdamW反超Muon，且模型越大，反超发生在越小的token与参数比上。作者把微调视为对输出的扰动，提出margin-to-spread ratio，衡量正确logit相对错误logit的领先幅度与错误logit的分散程度，该比值在Muon与AdamW间的差异与微调趋势一致；并在线性联想记忆模型中证明随数据预算增长，梯度下降的该比值会追上并反超Muon。结果说明优化器选择需结合预训练数据规模与模型规模。
arxiv.reason: 优化器对比与预训练—微调交互，含理论证明与新建模度量

arxiv.title: Not All Reasoning Generalizes: A Case Study on Learning Generalizable Reasoning Strategies in RLVR
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can enable generalizable improvement for large language model (LLM) reasoning. This paper studies how to incentivize such generalization via reasoning strategies. We study this question with a controllable equation-solving framework: finding multiple inputs x for equations f(x)=y, where f is a non-bijective string function. This setting makes reasoning strategies observable while supporting a clear definition of easy-to-hard out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts, e.g., more solutions, longer y, etc. We uncover a subtle RLVR failure: it teaches the model to solve in-distribution tasks with high accuracy and structured step-by-step derivation, yet under OOD shifts, the same model abandons derivation and collapses to ineffective brute-force enumeration, causing sharp accuracy drops. This observation reveals the deeper challenges of RLVR generalization as it is neither incapable base model nor reward hacking, since the model succeeds in-distribution with the correct reasoning strategy. The key to mitigating this failure is an indirect intervention that surprisingly helps: co-training with bijective inversion tasks. Although these bijective tasks are actually not uniformly harder and even further from the non-bijective OOD evaluation, they make derivation more certain and substantially restore the correct strategy and accuracy under OOD shifts. This effect further motivates our theoretical analysis: outcome-only RLVR can shape reasoning processes through implicitly crediting the effective reasoning strategies more, even without process supervision. To conclude, our analysis framework and findings systematically reveal the crucial role and incentivization of reasoning strategies in RLVR generalization under OOD shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/ziqipang/rl_meta_thinking.
arxiv.titleZh: 并非所有推理都能泛化：关于 RLVR 中学习可泛化推理策略的案例研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 用一个可控的方程求解框架（为非双射字符串函数 f 找出多个输入 x 使 f(x)=y）考察 RLVR 能否学到可泛化的推理策略，该设定使推理策略可观测，并能构造易到难的 OOD 偏移（更多解、更长的 y 等）。实验揭示一种隐性失败：模型在分布内准确率高且给出结构化的逐步推导，但在 OOD 偏移下放弃推导、退化为低效的暴力枚举，准确率骤降；这既不是基座模型能力不足，也不是 reward hacking。与双射反演任务联合训练这一间接干预可显著恢复 OOD 下的正确策略与准确率，理论分析进一步表明仅用结果监督的 RLVR 可通过隐式地更多为有效推理策略记分来塑造推理过程。
arxiv.reason: RLVR 泛化与推理策略机制研究，直击后训练方向

arxiv.title: FADE: Factored Ability--Difficulty Filtering for Online RLVR Scheduling
arxiv.abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) learns only from prompts whose sampled completions disagree: all-pass and all-fail groups produce zero relative advantage and burn generation budget without moving the policy. Adaptive schedulers try to steer rollouts toward informative prompts, yet they rely on per-prompt pass-rate trackers that entangle two quantities evolving at very different speeds---the policy's shifting competence across reasoning skills and each prompt's intrinsic difficulty. When a single exponential average or Beta counter tracks both at once, short memory scrambles the relative ordering of prompts whereas long memory reports stale pass rates. We introduce FADE (Factored Ability--Difficulty Estimation), a bilinear state-space filter that separates the two timescales. FADE represents each prompt's success logit as the inner product of a whitened $K$-dimensional skill loading with a fast-drifting policy ability vector, minus a slow-shrinking scalar item intercept. Using Pólya--Gamma augmentation, each minibatch of binary rollout outcomes updates the $K$-dimensional ability posterior in closed form via a rank-$K$ Woodbury step, instantly transferring competence shifts to all unobserved prompts that share those skills while leaving item intercepts stable. From the resulting posterior mean and variance we derive a closed-form utility for the probability of drawing a non-degenerate rollout group. Across five reasoning benchmarks, two base models, and four scheduling paradigms under a matched rollout budget, FADE consistently improves downstream accuracy and calibration while adding less than $0.6$\,ms per step.
arxiv.titleZh: FADE：面向在线 RLVR 调度的能力—难度因子化过滤
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对RLVR中全对或全错的采样组优势为零、白耗生成预算的问题，自适应调度器通常用单条指数平均或Beta计数器同时跟踪策略能力与题目难度，导致短记忆打乱相对排序、长记忆给出过时通过率。FADE把每个prompt的成功logit建模为白化K维技能载荷与快速漂移策略能力向量的内积，再减去缓慢收缩的标量题目截距，借Pólya–Gamma增广以rank-K Woodbury步闭式更新能力后验，并由后验均值与方差推出抽取非退化rollout组的闭式效用。在五个推理benchmark、两个基模型、四种调度范式、匹配rollout预算下，下游准确率与校准均稳定提升，每步额外开销不足0.6ms。
arxiv.reason: RLVR在线调度，分离能力与难度双时间尺度，直击后训练

arxiv.title: Thought-deciphering via hierarchical EEG-to-text alignment
arxiv.abstract: Communication is important for our well-being, but it can be impaired by disabilities, such as locked-in syndrome (LIS), cerebral palsy (CP), and dysarthria. Non-invasive brain-to-text brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) offer a promising solution by providing an alternative communication pathway for people with communication disabilities. However, most recent breakthroughs have relied on large, cumbersome, and costly neuroimaging modalities, such as functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) and magnetoencephalography (MEG). Numerous studies have attempted decoding using the lighter and cheaper electroencephalography (EEG), but the results remain inferior compared to the other modalities. More importantly, we do not understand how these modalities are related to text at the letter, word, sentence, and higher semantic levels. Many prior studies have focused on decoding below the sentence level because it is considerably easier to design an experiment around phonemes, letters, and words. However, during communication, sentences play a much more important role than words and letters. This is because sentences carry information at such a high level that they can be understood even if some words and letters are missing. However, within sentence-level decoding, sentence classification is not as well investigated as sentence generation, making it difficult to decide whether a sentence should be retrieved or generated in the context of EEG-to-text decoding. This paper strives to investigate sentence-level EEG-to-text classification via a novel hierarchical alignment framework, where the main goal is to retrieve a read sentence using its context and EEG as inputs.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于层级 EEG 到文本对齐的思维解码
arxiv.summaryZh: 非侵入式脑机接口的文本解码长期依赖 fMRI、MEG 等昂贵模态，轻便廉价的 EEG 解码效果明显落后，且字母、词、句以及更高语义层级与文本之间的对应关系尚不清楚。该工作聚焦此前研究较少的句子级 EEG 到文本分类，提出层级对齐框架，把 EEG 信号与读过的句子在字母、词、句等多个层级上对齐，并以句子上下文和 EEG 作为输入，完成句子检索。其目标是厘清句子级解码应当采用检索还是生成路线，为低成本 EEG 通信通路提供可行方案。
arxiv.reason: EEG 脑机接口文本解码，属偏门交叉方向，与 LLM 主线关联有限

arxiv.title: Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents
arxiv.abstract: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. Today that second half is written by hand, and the experience of building one strategy never carries to the next. We introduce Strategist, a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks. Each strategy is written as a blueprint,executable code that other strategies can reuse, and together the blueprints form a library. Given a task and a small development set, Strategist retrieves related blueprints, writes candidate strategies, tests them on real samples, and revises them from the results. Every candidate then enters the library, so later tasks build on earlier discoveries. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy (74.7% vs.74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost. Its strategies also transfer to unseen tasks and other models without further search. The part of an AI system that is not improved on its own now does.
arxiv.titleZh: Strategist:用 Agent 演化推理策略
arxiv.summaryZh: AI agent 系统中负责把模型调用组织成回答的推理策略长期靠人工编写，一次构建的经验难以迁移到下一个系统。Strategist 让一个 meta-agent 把推理策略写成可执行、可复用的 blueprint 代码并汇成策略库:给定任务与小规模开发集后，它检索相关 blueprint、生成候选策略、在真实样本上实测，并据结果迭代修改，候选策略再回流入库，使后续任务继承先前发现。在 30 个 benchmark 上，它在 24 个上超过最强基线，平均准确率 74.7% 对 74.0%，推理成本降低 39%，策略还能零搜索迁移到未见任务与其他模型。
arxiv.reason: Agent 自演化推理策略，直接命中 Agent 与自进化方向，实验扎实

arxiv.title: Tracing the Scientific Discovery Capacity of LLMs to Their Training Data
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show growing promise for scientific discovery, yet basic questions remain about what enables reliable discovery. How can we trace the scientific discovery capacity of LLMs to their training data? We study this question as one of missing probability mass and develop a theoretical account in which monofacts-the facts observed once during training-set the discovery capacity. In materials science and regulatory genomics, we directly manipulate monofact rates in training sets and find that more monofacts consistently yield more discoveries across two open-weight model families, sampling strategies, and reasoning budgets. Further experiments show the relationship cannot be explained by training-set diversity alone and can transfer across scientific domains when paired with in-domain data. Together, our results identify monofact rate in training data as a key factor governing discoveries in language models.
arxiv.titleZh: 将LLM的科学发现能力溯源至其训练数据
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究LLM的科学发现能力从何而来:以「缺失概率质量」为切入点建立理论框架，指出训练集中仅出现一次的「单次事实」(monofact)决定了模型的发现能力。在材料科学与调控基因组学中直接调控训练集的monofact比例，发现更高的monofact率在两个开放权重模型族、不同采样策略与推理预算下都稳定带来更多发现。进一步实验显示该关系无法仅用训练集多样性解释，且在搭配领域内数据时可跨学科迁移。这为预训练数据筛选与科研型LLM的数据配比提供了可量化、可操作的指标。
arxiv.reason: 用monofact刻画预训练数据与科学发现能力的关系，属AI for Research

arxiv.title: Benchmark Prediction with Sparse and Unpaired Cached Responses
arxiv.abstract: Evaluating a generative model on all queries from all available benchmark tasks is prohibitively expensive. As such, models are often evaluated on different subsets of tasks and/or different subsets of queries from a given task. The resulting collection of responses and the corresponding (model, task) score matrix are sparse and unpaired. In this paper, we introduce the Product Kernel Perspective Space (PKPS), a collection of low-dimensional representations of models based on their embedded responses. PKPS generalizes existing methods for representing black-box generative models by comparing responses to similar -- rather than just identical -- queries and is therefore able to utilize sparse and unpaired information. Theoretically, we show that benchmark prediction using PKPS is query-efficient relative to methods that only use information from dense and paired portions of the evaluation data. Empirically, we show that PKPS-based methods outperform baselines on benchmark prediction across two large benchmark suites.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于稀疏且不成对缓存响应的基准预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 评估生成模型时往往只能在部分任务、部分查询上采样，使(model, task)得分矩阵稀疏且不成对，难以预测未评测组合的表现。论文提出Product Kernel Perspective Space(PKPS)，把模型表示为基于嵌入响应的低维向量，通过将响应与「相似」而非仅「相同」查询比对，从而利用稀疏、不成对信息。理论上证明PKPS的基准预测相较仅用稠密成对数据的方法更具查询效率，实验上在两个大型基准套件上优于基线。
arxiv.reason: 评测方法学中的稀疏基准预测，方向擦边且方法扎实

arxiv.title: Efficient Closure Learning in Dynamical Systems: A Comparison of Data-Assimilated and Embedded Approaches
arxiv.abstract: Increased computing power has transformed computational science and improved predictive capabilities for complex systems, but many phenomena still exceed current simulation capabilities or require rapid evaluations for fast design iterations. Closure models address this challenge by approximating unresolved effects in reduced or incomplete dynamical systems. Data-driven closures offer a flexible mechanism for improving model accuracy and applicability, but approaches that embed the closure within a computational model for construction and training phases can be computationally expensive and cause numerical instabilities in the computational model during training. To avoid the challenges posed by embedded approaches, staged approaches to closure-model learning have been developed. The first stage uses data assimilation to infer state and closure trajectories from observations. The second stage trains a machine learning closure model offline using the assimilated data, thereby avoiding repeated simulator calls during training. In this work, we investigate the cost and accuracy tradeoffs between embedded and staged data-driven closure modeling approaches for a synthetic epidemiological SIQR model with a nonlinear state-dependent quarantine closure. The results illustrate a practical accuracy-efficiency trade-off: for this exemplar, embedded training provides the strongest average accuracy, while the staged approach yields comparable qualitative behavior with a moderate increase in error, substantially fewer model evaluations, and improved optimization robustness.
arxiv.titleZh: 动力系统中的高效闭合学习：数据同化方法与嵌入式方法的比较
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对降阶或不完整动力系统中未解析效应的闭合模型，比较嵌入式（在仿真器内构造并训练）与分阶段（先用数据同化推断状态与闭合轨迹，再用同化数据离线训练机器学习闭合模型）两种数据驱动闭合学习方法的成本与精度权衡；在含非线性、依赖状态的隔离项的合成SIQR流行病模型上，嵌入式训练的平均精度最高，分阶段方法的误差适度增加，但模型评估次数大幅减少，优化也更稳健。该权衡为仿真器昂贵的场景下如何选择闭合建模策略提供了参考。
arxiv.reason: 科学计算闭合建模与数据同化，与LLM/Agent方向无交集

arxiv.title: ufakzeka-kulak: Building and Evaluating a 31.6M-Parameter Turkish Speech Recognizer from Scratch
arxiv.abstract: ufakzeka-kulak is an open Turkish speech-to-text model of 31.6M parameters, a FastConformer encoder with a token-and-duration transducer (TDT) and a CTC head, trained from scratch and released under Apache-2.0. It writes cased, punctuated Turkish with numbers as words. Its 4,977 training hours come from sources whose licences allow commercial use; 281 hours are human-transcribed, and for the other 4,696 the training text is an uploader subtitle or a machine transcript, kept only where a second, independent reading of the audio agrees with it. The recipe, checkpoint, labelling and export choices were made on development data, and the test sets were scored once, in a release gate fixed before training. With greedy TDT decoding the normalised word error rate (WER) is 0.0921 (95 percent interval 0.0792 to 0.1055) on FLEURS Turkish test and 0.0916 (0.0873 to 0.0958) on Common Voice 27.0 Turkish test, lower than Whisper base and Whisper small on both sets with paired intervals wholly below zero; Whisper large-v3 (greedy) scores 0.0604 and 0.0767. On conversational speech the WER is 0.3807. We also report punctuation and casing, degraded audio, and how closely each shipped export reproduces the trained model.
arxiv.comment: 9 pages (text on pages 1 to 8, references on pages 8 and 9). Model, card, attribution, code and demo: https://huggingface.co/ufakai/ufakzeka-kulak, https://github.com/ufakai/ufakzeka-kulak, https://kulak.ufakzeka.com
arxiv.titleZh: ufakzeka-kulak:从零构建并评估一个31.6M参数的土耳其语语音识别器
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向土耳其语缺乏许可友好的开源ASR这一问题，从零训练31.6M参数的FastConformer编码器，配token-and-duration transducer(TDT)与CTC双头，输出带大小写、标点且数字转写为词形的文本。训练数据共4977小时，均来自允许商用的来源，其中4696小时用上传者字幕或机器转写作为标签，仅在第二路独立识别结果与之一致时保留。贪心TDT解码下FLEURS土耳其语测试集归一化WER为0.0921(95%区间0.0792–0.1055),Common Voice 27.0为0.0916，均低于Whisper base与small且配对区间完全在零以下;Whisper large-v3对应0.0604与0.0767，会话语音WER为0.3807。
arxiv.reason: 土耳其语语音识别模型训练，属语音应用低分方向

arxiv.title: DiabAgent: Toward Agentic Physiological Control
arxiv.abstract: As pretraining scales, medical language models have advanced rapidly in clinical question answering. Their ability to achieve effective physiological control through sustained intervention still lacks systematic quantitative evaluation. Type 1 diabetes provides a concrete setting: impaired insulin secretion creates dependence on exogenous insulin, with dosing continually adjusted using information about meals, exercise, illness, and glucose measurements. We introduce DiabAgent, a research suite for agentic physiological control comprising the Agentic Physiological Control (APC) framework, the DiabetSim simulator, and the SweetBench benchmark. APC controls glucose through medical-device tools, using ongoing observations to infer individual states, accumulate personal experience, and choose treatment actions. We build DiabetSim to simulate different patients, events, and device conditions for scalable virtual testing and training. Using DiabetSim, we construct SweetBench by instantiating 32 scenario designs as 212 glucose-control tasks. With Claude Opus 5.5 and a fixed decision interval of one hour, APC achieves a COGI of 73.5, compared with 71.2 for the open-source closed-loop baseline OpenAPS. Ablations further show that individual adaptation and contextual information improve glucose control. Combining high-frequency rule-based control with lower-frequency agent decisions shows potential for balancing control performance and computational cost. Our work provides a framework, simulator, and evaluation foundation for agents to participate in human physiological control.
arxiv.titleZh: DiabAgent：迈向具身式生理控制
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对医疗语言模型缺乏持续干预下生理控制能力的量化评估问题，以 1 型糖尿病胰岛素给药为场景，提出 Agentic Physiological Control（APC）框架，通过医疗设备工具进行血糖控制，并依据持续观测推断个体状态、积累个人经验并选择治疗动作；同时构建 DiabetSim 模拟器与 SweetBench 基准，将 32 个场景设计实例化为 212 个血糖控制任务。在固定 1 小时决策间隔下，APC 配合 Claude Opus 5.5 取得 73.5 的 COGI，高于开源闭环基线 OpenAPS 的 71.2；消融显示个体自适应与上下文信息均有增益，高频规则控制与低频智能体决策结合可平衡效果与算力开销。该工作为智能体参与人体生理控制提供了框架、模拟器与评测基础。
arxiv.reason: 医疗垂直应用，仅擦边 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Four Bridges: Measuring Deception Propensity in a Multi-Agent Game
arxiv.abstract: AI agents are increasingly deployed in settings where they interact and coordinate with other agents, yet honesty is mostly measured in single-turn, single-agent benchmarks that pressure the model to deceive. We study deception that emerges in multi-agent interaction without any instruction to deceive. We introduce Kradle, a platform for evaluating AI models, and Four Bridges, an information asymmetry game in which four agents distribute across four rooms: one is the death room, the others hold food worth more if not shared. One agent, the informed agent, knows which room is the death room and can withhold or disclose that information. We evaluate eight frontier models as the informed agent. Deceptive behavior appears in every model and in 73% of all runs (6% to 100% per model), and does not decrease with capability tier within a model family. When the informed agent does disclose, the warning is often challenged, and agents that challenge it enter the death room twice as often as those that do not. Telling all agents that one of them knows the death room collapses deception in six of eight models; telling the informed agent that the room is permanently fatal moves only one. On an open-weight model, an honesty steering vector reduces deception to 0% and adversarial honesty training to 6%. The platform and game provide a testbed for measuring deceptive behavior and comparing interventions.
arxiv.titleZh: Four Bridges：测量多智能体博弈中的欺骗倾向
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有诚实性评测多局限于单轮、单智能体，并且往往通过施加压力来诱发欺骗，而在没有欺骗指令的情况下，多智能体交互中自发出现的欺骗行为还缺乏测量手段。为此，该工作提出 Kradle 评测平台与 Four Bridges 信息不对称博弈：四个智能体分处四室，其中一间是死亡之室，其余房间藏有食物，知情智能体可以选择隐瞒或披露这一信息。当八个前沿模型作为知情者时，它们都出现了欺骗行为，73% 的试验中发生了欺骗（各模型为 6%–100%），并且在同一模型家族内，该比例不随能力提升而下降；质疑警告的智能体进入死亡之室的比例翻倍。告知全体智能体“有一名知情者”后，八个模型中有六个的欺骗率骤降；在开源权重模型上，诚实引导向量可使欺骗率降至 0%，对抗性诚实训练可降至 6%。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体欺骗测量平台与干预实验，契合 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Should We Combine Our Data? Algorithms and Limits for Privately Assessing Data Sharing
arxiv.abstract: In this paper, we study when two parties should pool their data to train a machine learning model. Two agents, Alice and Bob, each hold a sensitive labeled dataset and want to train a classifier from a given hypothesis class $\mathcal{H}$. Even when each party's dataset can be perfectly classified on its own, the two parties may follow conflicting labeling standards or have selection biases that affect their features and label sets, such that no single classifier in $\mathcal{H}$ fits their combined data. Before committing to data sharing, Alice and Bob therefore want to test whether a single classifier in $\mathcal{H}$ can jointly fit both datasets---without revealing their individual data points to one another. We formalize this problem from a learning-theoretic viewpoint via $\operatorname{opt}_\mathcal{H}$, the minimum \emph{number of mistakes} made by any hypothesis in $\mathcal{H}$ on their pooled data. Through interactive communication, the agents must distinguish $\operatorname{opt}_\mathcal{H}=0$ (compatible datasets) from $\operatorname{opt}_\mathcal{H}\geq t$ (conflicting datasets) under pure $\varepsilon$-two-party differential privacy. A trusted curator could do this with $t=O(1/\varepsilon)$, and we ask how small $t$ can be without one. For thresholds on the real line over a domain of size $m$, we show that the optimal $t$ is $\tildeΘ(\log\log m/\varepsilon)$, exponentially smaller than the $Θ(\log m/\varepsilon)$ samples needed to privately learn thresholds, even with a curator. For halfspaces in $\mathbb{R}^d$, the dependence on $m$ jumps to $\log(m)$: we give a protocol with $t=\tilde{O}(d^3\log m/\varepsilon)$ and show that some domains require $t=Ω(d\log(m/d)/\varepsilon)$.
arxiv.titleZh: 是否应合并数据？隐私评估数据共享的算法与极限
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究两方在不愿互相泄露样本的前提下，是否应合并敏感标注数据训练同一分类器：即使各自数据可完美分类，标签标准或选择偏差也可能使合并后无单一假设能拟合。将问题形式化为合并数据上的最小错误数 opt_H，通过交互通信在纯 ε-双方差分隐私下区分 opt_H=0 与 opt_H≥t。对实数轴上的阈值（域大小 m），最优 t 为 tildeΘ(log log m/ε)，远小于即便有可信策展人时私下学习阈值所需的 Θ(log m/ε)；对 R^d 半空间，给出 t=tilde O(d^3 log m/ε) 的协议与 Ω(d log(m/d)/ε) 的下界，显示对 m 的依赖跃升为 log m。
arxiv.reason: 学习论与差分隐私理论，与 LLM 关注方向无关

arxiv.title: DynaSolver: A Neural Operator for Autoregressive 4D Flow Prediction with Dynamic Boundaries
arxiv.abstract: Neural operators provide efficient surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD), but most are designed for static geometries and are not equipped to model unsteady flows induced by continuously moving boundaries. We study dynamic-boundary 4D CFD prediction for articulated moving geometries and introduce RoboCFD-4D, a temporally resolved robotic CFD benchmark spanning diverse morphologies and flow conditions. To address the computational and autoregressive challenges of this setting, we propose DynaSolver, a neural operator that explicitly conditions on boundary evolution and causal flow history. DynaSolver employs an efficient physical-token formulation that amortizes point-to-token projection across the operator stack, substantially reducing repeated point-space spatio-temporal computation while retaining accurate point-level reconstruction. We further introduce Replay-Augmented Parallel Training, which exposes the model to autoregressively generated histories while preserving parallel dense supervision, narrowing the gap between ground-truth-conditioned training and autoregressive rollout. Experiments on RoboCFD-4D show that DynaSolver achieves the best full-rollout accuracy among a broad range of learned CFD surrogates, with its advantage increasing as rollout proceeds, indicating substantially reduced autoregressive error accumulation. Project page: https://made-gpt.github.io/DynaSolver-ProjectPage.
arxiv.titleZh: DynaSolver:一种面向动态边界自回归4D流动预测的神经算子
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向关节式运动几何体引发的动态边界4D CFD预测，构建了时间分辨的机器人流体仿真基准RoboCFD-4D，覆盖多种形态与流动条件。DynaSolver显式以边界演化和因果流历史为条件，采用物理token化表示，把点到token的投影摊薄到整个算子栈，降低重复的点空间时空计算并保留点级重建精度;同时提出回放增强并行训练，在保留并行稠密监督的同时让模型接触自回归生成的历史，缩小教师强制训练与自回归推演的差距。在RoboCFD-4D上，其完整推演精度优于多种学习型CFD代理模型，且优势随推演步数增加而扩大，表明自回归误差累积显著降低。工作面向机器人流体仿真代理建模，与LLM/Agent方向无关。
arxiv.reason: 机器人流体仿真神经算子，属具身/物理仿真低分方向

arxiv.title: Evaluating Uncertainty Calibration in Probabilistic Time Series Foundation Models
arxiv.abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are increasingly used for probabilistic forecasting across diverse domains, yet the reliability of their uncertainty estimates remains poorly understood. In this work, we study uncertainty calibration in probabilistic TSFMs from a broader methodological and empirical perspective. We introduce a taxonomy of how TSFMs represent predictive uncertainty and develop a fine-grained evaluation framework for calibration in multi-horizon forecasting that distinguishes pooled, horizon-wise, and stronger conditional notions of calibration. Using this framework, we conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation of popular TSFMs across diverse datasets and show that current models exhibit distinct and systematic patterns of miscalibration that standard metrics often obscure. We further analyze common post-hoc recalibration methods and characterize which forms of calibration they can improve and which tend to persist. Our results provide practical guidance for evaluating and improving uncertainty calibration in TSFMs and highlight important limitations of current practice.
arxiv.comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
arxiv.titleZh: 评估概率时序基础模型中的不确定性校准
arxiv.summaryZh: 时序基础模型（TSFM）已广泛用于概率预测，但其不确定性估计是否可靠仍缺乏系统检验。工作先给出 TSFM 表示预测不确定性的分类体系，再构建面向多步预测的细粒度校准评测框架，区分 pooled、逐 horizon 与更强的条件校准三种口径。在多个数据集上评测主流 TSFM 后发现普遍存在系统性误校准，且常被标准指标掩盖;进一步刻画事后重校准方法能改善哪类校准、哪类持续存在。
arxiv.reason: 时序基础模型校准评测，仅方法学上沾边，与 LLM 主线关联弱

arxiv.title: A Scaling Theory of Multi-Epoch Pretraining: Late-Time Overfitting and Ensembling
arxiv.abstract: In the near future language model pretraining will become bound by total data rather than total compute. Such a regime requires revisiting scaling laws and scaling law theory. Motivated by prior works that have found utility in ensembling, we study how the number of training epochs and ensemble size jointly shape generalization when training data are fixed. In language-model experiments on FineWeb, logit averaging reduces late-training deterioration, delays optimal stopping, and can outperform wider or deeper single models at matched parameter-token budgets over a common training horizon. To analyze this interaction between data reuse and ensembling, we derive a dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) for multi-epoch stochastic gradient descent in power-law random-feature ensembles, tracking error correlations across epochs and models. Ensembling reduces the prediction variance responsible for late-time growth in expected test error, changing the optimal stopping time. We use these stopping times to derive compute-allocation laws at fixed data and individual model sizes. Under this allocation, ensemble size grows with compute at least as fast as training time per member, while excess test loss above the limiting loss decreases as a power of compute.
arxiv.titleZh: 多轮预训练的一个缩放理论:晚期过拟合与集成
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对预训练即将从算力受限转向数据受限的趋势，研究数据固定时训练轮数与集成规模如何共同决定泛化。在 FineWeb 上的语言模型实验显示，logit 平均能缓解训练后期的性能退化、推迟最优停止点，并在参数- token 预算与训练时长匹配的条件下优于更宽或更深的单模型。理论上为幂律随机特征集成下的多轮 SGD 推导出动力学平均场理论(DMFT)，追踪跨轮次与跨模型的误差相关性，说明集成通过压低预测方差改变最优停止时间。据此给出固定数据与单体规模下的算力分配律:集成规模随算力的增长速度不低于每个成员的训练时长，而超出极限损失的部分按算力的幂律衰减。
arxiv.reason: 数据受限预训练的多轮 scaling law 理论与实验，直击预训练方向

arxiv.title: FedReady: Bounded Agents for Federation Formation
arxiv.abstract: Federated learning (FL) runtimes standardize aggregation and deployment, but each new study still requires federation formation: selecting task-eligible sites and preparing their local data and task code for federated training or analysis. This preparation recurs when the target changes, while raw records and site-private mappings are excluded from cross-site FL messages. We present FedReady, a system that performs federation formation with bounded LLM agents. Agents propose shared contracts, local adapters, and task code; the runtime owns workflow state and accepts artifacts only after checks tied to their digests. Candidate site discovery prioritizes recall; local eligibility verification checks task support before site admission. Once participating sites and artifacts are fixed, conventional federated training or analysis proceeds without readiness agents. Across 39 simulated retinal sites and four tasks, discovery reaches recall 1.00 at precision 0.65; local eligibility verification removes all 17 false positives without losing an eligible site-task pair. The participating sites supply 45,575 task-record instances and complete four 100-round jobs, including one with a runtime-generated contract. Across ten patient cohorts, preparation supports seven patient populations and holds endpoints at three sources as unsupported. Comparison with manually prepared reference populations and analysis (the manual reference) gives a maximum survival-curve difference of 0.001133. We also analyze 19 development failures, targeted classification ablations, and standalone and heterogeneous agent configurations. These results establish the feasibility of task-specific data preparation before ordinary FL training or analysis.
arxiv.titleZh: FedReady：用于联邦组建的受限智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 联邦学习每次新研究都需重新组建联邦：挑选任务合格站点，并准备其本地数据与任务代码，而原始记录与站点私有映射不能跨站传输。FedReady 用受限 LLM 智能体提出共享契约、本地适配器与任务代码，运行时掌握工作流状态，并且只有当产物的摘要校验通过后才接收该产物；候选站点发现优先保证召回，本地资格验证在站点准入前检查任务支持情况。在39个模拟视网膜站点、4个任务上，发现的召回率为1.00、精确率为0.65，资格验证剔除全部17个假阳性且未丢失合格站点—任务对；参与站点提供45,575条任务记录，完成4个100轮作业，与人工参考的最大生存曲线差异为0.001133。结果表明，在常规联邦训练或分析前用智能体完成任务特定数据准备是可行的。
arxiv.reason: LLM智能体用于联邦组建，但落在医疗联邦垂直场景

arxiv.title: Sonar-MoE: In-Backward Expert Updates for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
arxiv.abstract: Most parameters of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model belong to its experts, and standard training keeps every expert gradient in GPU memory until the optimizer step. This memory grows with the number and size of the experts, so it rises as MoE models scale. We introduce Sonar-MoE, which updates each expert tensor during the backward pass and frees its gradient right away. It brings optimizer-in-backward from dense models to batched MoE expert tensors, so the GPU never holds more than one layer of expert gradients. When we fine-tune OLMoE-1B-7B and Granite-3.1-3B-A800M in bf16 with two expert-kernel backends, Sonar-MoE lowers peak memory by 19% to 22%. Its updates are bitwise identical to standard training without expert gradient clipping, and held-out loss stays within 0.003 of all baselines. Each step also takes 17% to 23% less time than standard training with global-norm clipping. Updating whole batched tensors rather than individual experts is what keeps Sonar-MoE fast, as it avoids a 20% to 72% slowdown while using the same memory. Sonar-MoE matches optimizer-in-backward over all parameters in memory and speed while still clipping the dense parameters.
arxiv.titleZh: Sonar-MoE：面向内存高效混合专家训练的反向传播内专家更新
arxiv.summaryZh: MoE 模型的专家梯度需全部驻留 GPU 直到优化器更新，显存随专家数量与规模增长。Sonar-MoE 在反向传播过程中即更新每个专家张量并立刻释放梯度，将 dense 模型的 optimizer-in-backward 推广到批量化的专家张量，使 GPU 至多保留一层专家梯度。在 bf16 下微调 OLMoE-1B-7B 与 Granite-3.1-3B-A800M，峰值显存降低 19%–22%，更新与无专家梯度裁剪的标准训练逐位一致，留出集 loss 偏差不超过 0.003，每步比带全局范数裁剪的标准训练快 17%–23%。该方法为大规模 MoE 后训练提供了显存与速度双收益的工程方案。
arxiv.reason: MoE 训练显存优化，属高效训练方向，结果扎实但偏工程

arxiv.title: NitiBench+: A Temporal Thai Legal Question Answering Benchmark Across 17 Domains
arxiv.abstract: Law changes over time. A court decides a case under the law in force on that day, and legal QA benchmarks grade answers against today's law. We checked 156,650 decisions of four Thai courts. Up to 67% of them cite law that has since been amended or repealed. We introduce NitiBench+, the sequel of our NitiBench, a Thai legal QA benchmark with 1,670 items across 17 domains, built from decisions of three courts. For each cited section it holds both the text in force on the decision date and the current text, and its retrieval corpus holds every dated version of every Thai statute section. Answers are graded on the Thai Bar Council rubric, the Bar-standard score, and on the overlap between the cited sections and the court's. The report has two parts. Part I measures the cost of the wrong text on 13 open-weight models. Reading the current text of amended law drops the Bar-standard score by 0.25 and missing repealed law drops it by 0.79. The penalty comes from rule changes, 0.45 on the 428 rule-changed items and none on the 331 wording-only items, and Citation F1 does not see it. The text in force is the fair setting. Part II benchmarks today's models on that setting. A public leaderboard ranks 26 models on a held-out test split of 500 items stratified by domain, with a validation split of the same shape released for public use, from memory alone, with the court's sections provided, and as a retrieval agent over the law in force, with the cost per item and the hallucinated citations. The best model scores 7.78 out of 10 and the best open-weight model 6.39. Without a search tool only five open-weight models recall any Thai law, and with it twenty of the 26 models gain and six lose. Leaderboard will take new models as they are released. Legal benchmarks must track dates, and on the right text today's models still leave a wide gap on Thai law.
arxiv.titleZh: NitiBench+:跨17个领域的时序泰国法律问答基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 法律会随时间修订，但现有法律问答基准都用现行法评分;检查泰国四家法院156,650份判决，多达67%引用了已修订或废止的条文。NitiBench+覆盖17个领域共1,670题，为每个被引条文同时保存判决当日有效文本与现行文本，语料收录泰国法条的全部版本，按泰国律师协会标准与引用重合度评分。在13个开源模型上，读现行文本使Bar-standard分数降0.25，缺失已废止条文降0.79,Citation F1对此不敏感;在有效文本设定下评测26个模型，最佳7.78/10、最佳开源6.39，加入检索后20个模型提升、6个下降。
arxiv.reason: 时序化法律基准并含检索智能体评测，方法学有参考价值但属垂直领域

arxiv.title: VeriHarm-Bench: Measuring Harmful Success in LLM Coding Agents Verifiably
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents increasingly operate with shell access, allowing them to write scripts, move files, alter permissions, and modify system configurations. However, an agent may achieve a user's goal while causing unintended harm, such as deleting unrelated files, weakening access controls, or corrupting data, in response to benign inputs without explicit jailbreaking. This failure mode is particularly important because apparent task success may reassure users that an agent behaved correctly, causing harmful side effects to go unnoticed. We call this harmful success: the agent successfully completes the intended benign task while simultaneously causing unintended harm. Despite its importance, harmful success is difficult to measure because conventional task-success metrics overlook harmful behaviors, while existing safety evaluations are often designed solely to assess harmful outcomes. We introduce VeriHarm, an automatic framework for constructing programmatically verifiable benchmarks that directly measure harmful success. VeriHarm minimally perturbs coding tasks to elicit unintended harmful behavior while maintaining the benignity of the task and preserving the original task objective. It then synthesizes executable harm tests that, together with the original task-correctness tests, evaluate both task accuracy and harmful outcomes. Frontier agents, including GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, achieve an average task accuracy of 95% on our curated VeriHarm-Bench, yet still struggle to complete tasks safely: their safe success rate, the fraction of tasks completed successfully without triggering the designated harm, averages only 37%. These results suggest that successful task completion can frequently coexist with unintended harm, and that task-success metrics alone may substantially understate the potential safety risks of coding agents.
arxiv.titleZh: VeriHarm-Bench：可验证地度量LLM编程智能体中的有害成功
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM编程智能体拥有shell权限后，可能在完成良性任务时删除无关文件、削弱访问控制或损坏数据；这种“有害成功”会被任务成功率掩盖，现有安全评测又只关注有害结果。VeriHarm自动构造可编程验证的基准：最小扰动编码任务以诱发有害行为，同时保留良性目标，并合成可执行危害测试，与正确性测试联合评估准确率和危害结果。在VeriHarm-Bench上，GPT-5.6-Sol、Claude-Opus-5等前沿智能体平均准确率达95%，安全成功率仅37%，表明单看任务成功会显著低估编程智能体的安全风险。
arxiv.reason: 编程智能体安全基准，直击Agent与评测方向

arxiv.title: BISECT: Bilevel Spectral Decomposition for Low-Rank Continual Learning
arxiv.abstract: Exemplar-free continual learning on pre-trained Vision Transformers increasingly relies on Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), yet prevailing methods govern the low-rank update space through strict subspace isolation. By projecting each incoming task into the approximate null space of historical token activations, isolation-based learners equate any cross-task feature overlap with catastrophic interference. We show that this orthogonality premise induces a structural bottleneck we term \emph{spectral starvation}: when down-projection bases are locked before task optimization, the gradient norm reaching the trainable up-projection is upper-bounded by the energy of current-task features captured by the chosen basis. Because natural visual tasks share low- and mid-level covariance structure, historical null tails contain barely $5.5\%$ of incoming task variance, starving new-class plasticity while blocking positive consolidation along shared directions. We propose BISECT (Bilevel Spectral Decomposition), a continual LoRA framework that partitions a fixed rank-$r$ budget into two orthogonal functional blocks: an invariant carrier spanned by the dominant modes of the joint historical-and-current Gram matrix, and a novelty complement extracted via generalized Rayleigh whitening followed by orthogonal complement projection. After single-task training, BISECT folds both blocks back into the frozen backbone using a closed-form precision gate that scales each rank-1 invariant atom by its current-to-joint Rayleigh ratio while preserving novelty atoms at unit gain. Across eight incremental settings on ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and DomainNet, BISECT outperforms prompt, adapter, and LoRA baselines with zero extra inference parameters or FLOPs, and remains complementary to sparse analytic expansion.
arxiv.titleZh: BISECT:用于低秩持续学习的双层谱分解
arxiv.summaryZh: 无样本持续学习通常用LoRA，但主流做法靠严格子空间隔离约束低秩更新空间，把任何跨任务特征重叠都当成灾难性干扰;这种正交性前提会导致「谱饥饿」:历史零空间仅覆盖新任务5.5%的方差，既压制新类可塑性，也阻断共享方向上的正向巩固。BISECT把固定秩r预算拆成两个正交功能块:由历史与当前联合Gram矩阵主模态张成的不变载体，以及经广义Rayleigh白化与正交补投影提取的新颖补块;单任务训练后用闭式精度门按当前与联合的Rayleigh比缩放各秩1不变原子、新颖原子保持单位增益，再折回冻结骨干。在ImageNet-R、ImageNet-A、CIFAR-100、CUB-200、DomainNet的八个增量设置上优于prompt、adapter与LoRA基线，且不增加推理参数与FLOPs。
arxiv.reason: 视觉持续学习中的LoRA谱分解，与LLM后训练仅弱相关

arxiv.title: Can LLM Agents Be Forward-Deployed Engineers? Requirement Discovery and Delivery for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
arxiv.abstract: LLM coding agents can increasingly automate model post-training, but whether they can act as forward-deployed engineer (FDE) agents, discovering customer requirements and turning them into deployment decisions, remains unclear. We study this on a real enterprise text-to-SQL engagement: a simulated customer, grounded in the real use case's requirements, starts with an ambiguous request. An agent must discover acceptance criteria, data permissions, and hardware constraints in the discovery phase, then plan and execute a post-training recipe in the delivery phase. Across 15 models, the strongest discover over 80% of withheld requirements and open-weight models discover 40-50%; in the delivery phase, only 25% of runs across eight coding-agent configurations pass all acceptance criteria. We identify four bottlenecks in this engagement: (1) incomplete discovery, with 40% of withheld requirements missing or misrepresented; (2) unreliable execution; (3) underused compute budgets and a lack of systematic comparisons across base models and post-training methods; and (4) benchmark accuracy does not guarantee production readiness. We suggest human review of discovered requirements, monitoring of the agent's plan during execution, and an explicit experiment-environment specification covering hardware, budget scope, and production checks.
arxiv.titleZh: LLM Agent 能否担任前部署工程师？企业级 Text-to-SQL 的需求发现与交付
arxiv.summaryZh: 在真实企业 text-to-SQL 项目中考察 LLM Agent 能否像前部署工程师（FDE）那样，先从模糊需求中挖掘验收标准、数据权限与硬件约束，再规划并执行后训练配方。模拟客户基于真实需求设置 15 个模型参与的需求发现阶段，最强模型能发现逾 80% 的隐藏需求，开源权重模型为 40–50%；交付阶段八种编码 Agent 配置中仅 25% 的运行通过全部验收标准。工作归纳出需求发现不完整、执行不可靠、算力预算利用不足、benchmark 准确率不等于生产可用四大瓶颈，并提出人工复核需求、监控执行计划与显式实验环境规范等建议。
