arxiv.title: Variational Functional Neural Networks (vfNN)
arxiv.abstract: We present a variational functional neural network (vfNN) algorithm that optimizes physically motivated continuum functionals in integral form (e.g., Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, or free energy) to find the states of a system. That way, vfNN bypasses solving the equations of motion (a.k.a. the Euler-Lagrange equations), which are in the form of differential equations. To this end, our approach is fundamentally different from conventional physics-informed neural networks (PINN) that solve differential equations by minimizing a phenomenological loss function involving higher order derivatives and ad hoc weight factors. In contrast, vfNN merely evaluates lower order derivatives of the generating functional and replaces the weight factors with rigorous physical scales. This also fundamentally changes the loss landscape, and the desired solutions may become unstable. For this emergent nonconvex optimization problem, we develop a quasi-Newton optimization algorithm with simulated annealing that converges to the solutions of the corresponding Euler-Lagrange equations of the functional regardless of their stability properties. Our simulations using vfNN give accurate results for benchmark systems governed by linear or nonlinear ordinary differential equations.
arxiv.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures. Version submitted for peer review
arxiv.titleZh: 变分泛函神经网络（vfNN）
arxiv.summaryZh: 直接对积分形式的物理泛函（拉格朗日量、哈密顿量、自由能）做变分优化以求解系统状态，从而绕过欧拉-拉格朗日微分方程的求解。与 PINN 通过最小化含高阶导数和人工权重因子的现象学损失不同，vfNN 只计算生成泛函的低阶导数，并用有物理量纲的尺度替代权重因子。这一改变重塑了损失地形，使目标解可能不稳定，为此作者设计了结合模拟退火的拟牛顿优化算法，使其无论解的稳定性如何都能收敛到对应欧拉-拉格朗日方程的解。在线性或非线性常微分方程控制的基准系统上，vfNN 给出了准确结果。
arxiv.reason: 物理泛函变分求解，属科学计算，与 LLM 关注方向基本无关

arxiv.title: An Agentic Framework for Automated Power System Studies and Grid Connection Assessment
arxiv.abstract: Connecting new generation and demand to the grid depends on two scarce skills: checking applications against a large, changing body of regulation, and running the network studies that decide where and how a project connects. We present Grid Agents, an AI system that brings both together, and the methodology we use to evaluate it. The Grid Ontology is its knowledge system. It represents the regulation, standards and engineering knowledge that grid work depends on, makes it searchable, and evolves as the agents learn from use. Every answer drawn from it rests on evidence the agents cite. Grid Studio is an agent system specialised for power-system engineering. It works in its own engineering environment with domain tools and a study framework, draws on the Grid Ontology, and relies on established solvers for every number it reports. In both, engineers make the decisions. We bring eight published power-system benchmark families, previously scattered across separate papers, into one suite of 519 tasks, and we verify not only each answer but the work behind it, by replaying the agent's tool calls. The Grid Ontology cites the right regulatory evidence more often than a general coding agent or retrieval pipelines, leads on LegalBench-RAG and ranks first on the public leaderboards of the Enterprise RAG Challenge and ViDoRe V3. Grid Studio scores highest on the 519 power-system tasks and is the fastest of all the systems we compare, both by a statistically significant margin. With an optimiser in the loop, its reinforcement packages cost 33-67% less on average than those the agent designs alone.
arxiv.comment: 8 pages for the main paper with 6 pages for Appendix
arxiv.titleZh: 智能体框架用于电力系统研究与并网评估自动化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对并网申请审核与网络研究两项稀缺技能，构建Grid Agents系统：Grid Ontology以可检索、可持续演进的方式表示法规、标准与工程知识，所有回答附引用证据；Grid Studio作为电力系统工程专用智能体，在自带工程环境中调用领域工具与研究框架，数值均交由成熟求解器计算，工程师保留决策权。将八个已发表的电力系统基准族整合为519项任务的统一套件，并通过重放工具调用核验解题过程而非仅答案。Grid Ontology在法规证据引用准确率上超过通用编码智能体与检索管线，在LegalBench-RAG领先，并在Enterprise RAG Challenge与ViDoRe V3公开榜单排名第一；Grid Studio在519项任务上得分最高且速度最快（统计显著），接入优化器后其加固方案成本平均降低33–67%。
arxiv.reason: 电力系统垂直应用，仅智能体框架与RAG评测沾边

arxiv.title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
arxiv.abstract: Computer programmers chain together the same reusable computational primitives, for example, conditional statements or loops, but in different orders to implement different algorithms. In contrast, existing language model architectures always execute their layers in the same order. We introduce Library of Layers (LoL), an architecture that dynamically orders its layers during inference to solve the problem at hand. LoL has a single hyperparameter, the size of its global library of transformer blocks, that allows it to transition seamlessly between parameter reuse and sparsity, generalizing the parameter-efficiency and FLOPs-efficiency tradeoffs of dense, depth-recurrent, and mixture of experts architectures in one unified family. We show that LoL achieves competitive performance with all three above baselines when pretrained on text data. On synthetic sudoku and maze data, we observe that the model employs distinct layer orderings to implement different solution strategies, and we can intervene on routing to force a model to apply a specific solution strategy to a problem instance. In a multilingual natural language setting, we find that LoL chooses different layer order patterns based on language and script. Similarly, we train LoL on safety data and fit probes to its router outputs, finding that these probes distinguish safe from unsafe text with high AUROC. LoL provides a path toward a future in which models dynamically compose their own computational graph, enabling more efficient and controllable reasoning.
arxiv.titleZh: 层库（LoL）：在运行时自适应排序 Transformer 层
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有语言模型在推理时始终以固定顺序执行各层，LoL 让模型在推理时动态选择并排列 Transformer 块。它维护一个全局层库，仅以库大小一个超参数，在参数复用与稀疏激活之间连续过渡，统一了稠密、深度循环与 MoE 三类架构的效率权衡，文本预训练上表现与三者相当。在数独与迷宫任务上，模型针对不同解法采用不同层序，干预路由即可强制指定解法；多语言场景中层序随语言与文字系统变化，安全数据上路由探针区分安全与不安全文本的 AUROC 很高。该工作指向模型自行组合计算图的更高效、更可控推理路径。
arxiv.reason: Transformer 层序动态路由新架构，统一稠密/循环/MoE，实验丰富

arxiv.title: Grading the Unannotated: Insights from the WorkRB Skill Extraction Challenge at RecSys-HR 2026
arxiv.abstract: Skill extraction benchmarks score models against a few human-annotated positives and treat every other skill in the vocabulary as equally wrong. At the scale of ESCO (13,939 skills) this binary view can reward models that rank the annotated positive high for the wrong reason, and hides semantically nonsensical predictions. The WorkRB Challenge at RecSys-HR 2026 replaces it with graded relevance: every candidate skill in a model's ranking window carries a 0 to 4 grade, and the leaderboard scores nDCG@100 against these grades. Since ternary judgements proved too coarse for objective annotation, relevance is decomposed into a cascade of four binary questions (same domain, activity mentioned, right granularity, replacement of a gold positive) that a smaller LLM judge can answer reliably; the labels are validated with blind human and frontier-model re-annotation. This paper documents the annotation methodology, the construction of five benchmark datasets (four with vacancy sentences as queries, one with lexically distant skill surface forms), the validation of the LLM cascade, and insights from the submissions. The field converged on multi-stage retrieve-and-rerank pipelines, whose gains come from clearing nonsense out of the ranking window rather than finding more positives: at the top of the leaderboard, the graded ordering is uncorrelated with what binary evaluation would have said. Graded labels expose much bigger gaps between top submissions and baselines than binary evaluation does, and show that semantic-understanding skill recommendation is still wide open. The clear next direction is bringing efficiency back: every submitted system we could size uses at least 42x, typically several hundred times, more parameters than the baselines it beats.
arxiv.titleZh: 为未标注数据打分：RecSys-HR 2026 WorkRB 技能抽取挑战赛的洞见
arxiv.summaryZh: 技能抽取评测只用少量人工标注的正例，而把词表内其余技能一律判错；在 ESCO 的 13,939 个技能规模下，这种只分对错的二元判定会掩盖语义上荒谬的排序。WorkRB 挑战赛改用分级相关性：模型排序窗口内每个候选技能都给出 0–4 级，榜单按 nDCG@100 计分；相关性被拆成同领域、提及活动、粒度正确、可替代金标正例四个二元问题并串成回答流程，由较小的 LLM 裁判回答，再用盲人工与前沿模型复标验证。论文记录了标注方法、五个基准数据集的构建、该流程的验证与参赛提交的洞见：系统普遍收敛到多阶段召回—重排流程，增益主要来自把无意义候选清出排序窗口，而非找到更多正例；榜首系统的分级排序与二值评测结论不相关，分级标签也拉大了与基线的差距，在可估算规模的上榜系统中，参数规模至少为基线的 42 倍。
arxiv.reason: LLM-as-judge级联标注与分级评测有方法新意，但落在HR技能抽取垂直场景

arxiv.title: DistDebug-Bench: Can LLM Agents Diagnose Bugs in Distributed Systems?
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents show strong potential in software engineering tasks such as competitive programming and code synthesis. Existing benchmarks, however, largely focus on small-scale settings such as self-contained Python modules, leaving distributed systems, an essential class of production software, under-examined. We introduce DistDebug-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating agents' ability to diagnose complex-system failures at the code level. It curates 120 high-quality real-world bugs from 11 widely used distributed systems, spanning 5 programming languages and 10 failure patterns. Through an extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs and agents, we identify substantial gaps between current agents and real-world debugging tasks. A recurring gap is tunnel vision due to a lack of explicit reasoning structure and nondeterminism from inconsistent tool-use scope. The benchmark and evaluator are available at https://github.com/OrderLab/distdebug-bench, with agent traces and a leaderboard at https://distdebug.com.
arxiv.comment: NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets. 41 pages, 10 figures, 24 tables. Benchmark: https://github.com/OrderLab/distdebug-bench. Website: https://distdebug.com
arxiv.titleZh: DistDebug-Bench：LLM Agent 能否诊断分布式系统中的缺陷？
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有软件工程 benchmark 多集中于自包含的 Python 小模块，分布式系统这类生产软件中的复杂故障诊断尚未被系统考察。该工作构建 DistDebug-Bench，从 11 个广泛使用的分布式系统中筛选 120 个真实缺陷，覆盖 5 种编程语言与 10 类故障模式，要求 Agent 在代码层面定位并诊断故障根因。对当前主流 LLM 与 Agent 的大规模评测显示其与真实调试任务存在明显差距，典型失败模式包括缺乏显式推理结构导致的「隧道视野」，以及工具使用范围不一致带来的不确定性。benchmark 与评测器、Agent 轨迹和榜单均已开源，可用于诊断类 Agent 的能力评估与改进。
arxiv.reason: 分布式系统调试 benchmark，直接命中 Agent 与代码智能评测方向

arxiv.title: VIAS: Value-Isolating Activation Steering for Multi-Value Alignment and Compliance for Organisations
arxiv.abstract: Organisations increasingly deploy large language model agents that must follow organisational values. We check whether activation steering, which adds vectors to a model's internal activations during generation without changing its weights, can improve compliance beyond prompting alone. Since most scenarios involve several values at once, we focus on multi-value steering. A simple way to build these vectors is to contrast responses that follow all values relevant to a scenario with responses that violate them. However, this gives nearly identical vectors for different values: they capture a general compliance signal rather than individual values, which limits their use when combining several values. We propose Value-Isolating Activation Steering (VIAS), which contrasts responses to the same scenario under two prompts, one listing all relevant values and one omitting a single target value. We keep a pair only if the target value changes from compliant to non-compliant and both responses still meet a minimum compliance level on the other values. We evaluate VIAS on PROTECT, a workplace compliance dataset where each scenario is tagged with relevant values from a 21-value taxonomy. VIAS reduces overlap between value vectors, making them better suited for multi-value steering, although this alone does not lead to independent control over each value. Combined with prompting, VIAS complies with every tagged value on 69.6% of scenarios for Qwen2.5-7B, 75.2% for Mistral-7B, and 72.6% for Phi-3.5-mini, outperforming prompting alone for all three models.
arxiv.titleZh: VIAS：面向组织多价值对齐与合规的价值隔离激活引导
arxiv.summaryZh: 组织部署 LLM agent 时要求其遵循多项组织价值，激活引导（在生成中向内部激活叠加向量、不改权重）能否在提示之外提升合规率尚不清楚。直接用「遵守全部价值」与「违反价值」的回复做对比构造向量，会得到近乎相同的方向，只捕捉到笼统的合规信号而非单个价值。VIAS 改为对比同一场景下两个提示的回复：一个列出全部相关价值，另一个省略某个目标价值，仅当目标价值由合规转为不合规、且其余价值仍保持最低合规水平时保留该样本对。在含 21 项价值标签的 PROTECT 职场合规数据集上，该方法降低了价值向量间的重叠，使多价值引导更可行（但未实现各价值的独立控制）；与提示结合后，Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Phi-3.5-mini 分别有 69.6%、75.2%、72.6% 的场景满足全部标签价值，三模型均优于单用提示。
arxiv.reason: 激活引导做多价值对齐，方法清晰但场景偏组织合规

arxiv.title: Ask, Don't Equip: Question-Driven Coding Agents for Deep Kernel Optimization
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents for GPU kernel optimization sit at two ends of a structure-freedom tradeoff. Scripted agents fix what the model does at each step, via a learned policy, an optimization menu, or fixed roles, and are sample-efficient where the recipe applies and stall where it does not. Open-ended agents let a self-directed model mutate a population of kernels and pay for the freedom in trials: thousands of evaluations, repeated edits, and wrong candidates. Both respond to hard targets by equipping the agent with more: parsed profiler output, disassembly analysis, retrieval over documentation and libraries, and stores of lessons. We argue that both lack direction, a hypothesis about where the remaining gap is, and that a short question asked at the right moment supplies it without narrowing what the agent may do next. We present KernelSeek, a question-driven agent that makes an existing CUDA kernel faster with no operator-specific knowledge and no faster implementation to imitate: a general-purpose coding agent, a minimal harness that enforces a verifiable goal, and questions at decision points, first from a human, then from a bank the agent applies to itself. On the same task, evaluator, hardware, and week, a tool-rich autonomous agent built in the prevailing style plateaued at 0.50x FlashAttention-3 after 133 model-driven steps; KernelSeek reached 1.13x. It then produced dependency-free FlashAttention forward kernels for Hopper and Blackwell, single CUDA files with no CUTLASS, CuTe, cuBLAS, or cuDNN, correct on all 182 scenarios per architecture and 1.16x FlashAttention-3 and 1.46x FlashAttention-4 (geometric mean). Across 162 human messages and 11.5K agent tool calls, every large gain followed a question that moved the agent to a different layer of the system or rejected a claimed limit, never one that supplied information. We release the kernels, harness, question bank, and all traces.
arxiv.titleZh: 提问而非装备：面向深度内核优化的提问驱动编程智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 GPU kernel 优化智能体在脚本化与开放式两端均缺乏方向感的问题，提出 KernelSeek:通用编程智能体配最小 harness 强制可验证目标，并在决策点插入提问，先由人类给出，后由智能体自问自答的题库存取。同一任务与评测环境下，工具丰富的自主智能体在 133 步模型驱动后停在 0.50x FlashAttention-3，而 KernelSeek 达到 1.13x，并产出 Hopper 与 Blackwell 上不依赖 CUTLASS/CuTe/cuBLAS/cuDNN 的 FlashAttention 前向 kernel,182 个场景全部正确，几何平均分别为 1.16x 与 1.46x。对 162 条人类消息与 11.5K 次工具调用的分析显示，所有大幅提升都紧随改变了系统层次或否定所谓上限的提问，而非提供信息的提问。
arxiv.reason: 代码智能体与 kernel 优化新范式，结果显著且直接命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: RASP: Read-All, Sparse-Plasticity Continual Learning in a Stationary-Size LoRA
arxiv.abstract: Parameter-efficient continual learning on pre-trained Vision Transformers largely relies on a costly premise: preventing catastrophic forgetting requires either spawning a dedicated LoRA branch per session---causing adapter parameters to scale linearly with task horizon---or applying sparse Mixture-of-Experts gating symmetrically to both forward and backward passes, which sacrifices representational rank at test time. We argue that reading consolidated knowledge and writing new task credit are fundamentally asymmetric operations. Because visual features in a shared low-rank space distribute across rank-1 atoms rather than localizing in disjoint task silos, forward inference should read all atoms at full rank capacity, whereas backward optimization should restrict plasticity to a sparse subset of input-aligned channels. We introduce RASP (Read-All, Sparse-Plasticity LoRA), which adapts a single stationary-size adapter across sequential tasks. At each step, a scene-modulated cosine router selects the top-$q$ unlocked atoms to receive gradients, blocks updates on the remaining $r-q$ channels, and penalizes Frobenius Gram coherence between active and non-updated output directions. Across sessions, the router's empirical activation trace and each atom's exact spectral norm form a zero-overhead geometric consolidation index $ω_j = \sqrt{\tilde{c}_j \tildeσ_j}$ that drives Cauchy step attenuation and boundary anchor locking. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, ImageNet-R, and ImageNet-A, RASP matches or surpasses branch-expanding LoRA learners under a strictly constant parameter footprint.
arxiv.titleZh: RASP:在固定规模 LoRA 中实现全读取与稀疏可塑性的持续学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 在持续微调预训练 ViT 时，若要防止灾难性遗忘，通常需要为每个任务新增一条 LoRA 分支，导致参数量随任务数量线性增长;或者在前向和反向传播中对称施加稀疏 MoE 门控，但这会在测试时降低表征秩。RASP 提出，读取已巩固知识与写入新任务信用本质上是不对称的:前向传播时以全秩读取所有 rank-1 原子;反向传播时只让场景调制余弦路由器选出的 top-q 未锁定原子接收梯度，并惩罚活跃通道与未更新的输出方向之间的 Frobenius Gram 相干性。跨 session 时，路由器激活轨迹与各原子谱范数共同构成零开销的几何巩固指数，用来驱动 Cauchy 步长衰减与边界锚锁定。在 CIFAR-100、CUB-200、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-A 上，RASP 在参数规模严格恒定的条件下追平或超过按任务扩展分支的 LoRA 学习器。
arxiv.reason: ViT 持续学习 PEFT，读写非对称机制有新意，但任务偏视觉、与 LLM 后训练仅擦边

arxiv.title: ST-GFM: Spectral-Temporal Graph Forecasting with Measured Perturbation Bounds and Masked Spectral Reconstruction
arxiv.abstract: Graph forecasters for sensor networks are trained in one regime and deployed in others, where sensor coupling and signal frequency content both change. We split this spectral shift into an operator channel and a frequency channel, each with a dimensionless measure. ST-GFM (Spectral-Temporal Graph Forecasting Model) filters every input step with Chebyshev and bidirectional diffusion filters on one learned, non-symmetric operator and alternates them with per-node temporal attention. For the operator channel we prove Frobenius-norm perturbation bounds for both graph branches, show that the Chebyshev bound is attained to first order, and compute its constant from the trained weights and the measured operator norm: 17.9 on METR-LA and 21.5 on PEMS-BAY. Under random edge dropout the trained layer moves by 2.0% to 3.1% of this bound. Masked Spectral Reconstruction (MSR), a self-supervised loss active in the first 40 epochs, matches the log power spectrum of the encoder output to that of the input. For small log-spectral residuals on unclamped bins it is proportional to an Itakura-Saito divergence to leading order. Removing it raises the 60-minute MAE by 0.30 on METR-LA, close to the 0.33 lost when all three self-supervised losses go. Under one shared evaluation pipeline, the 60-minute MAE of ST-GFM is 3.5% below a retrained STAEformer on METR-LA and 13.0% below it on PEMS-BAY. Its 60-minute MAE is 3.0980.017 on METR-LA (five seeds) and 1.5760.006 on PEMS-BAY (three seeds), the lowest PEMS-BAY MAE among twelve published baselines.
arxiv.comment: 21 Pages, 11 Figures, 12 Tables, Supplementary Materials attached, Under Review
arxiv.titleZh: ST-GFM：带实测扰动界与掩码谱重构的谱-时序图预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 传感器网络上的图预测模型常在一种工况下训练、在另一种工况下部署，传感器耦合关系与信号频率成分都会变化。ST-GFM 将这种谱漂移拆成算子通道与频率通道，并各给出一个无量纲度量：在单一学到的非对称算子上，用 Chebyshev 与双向扩散滤波器处理每个输入步，再与逐节点时序注意力交替；它为两个图分支证明 Frobenius 范数扰动界，说明 Chebyshev 界一阶可达，并由训练权重与实测算子范数算出常数（17.9 与 21.5），随机边丢弃下位移仅为该界的 2.0%–3.1%。掩码谱重构（MSR）在前 40 个 epoch 把编码器输出的对数功率谱对齐到输入，小残差下近似 Itakura-Saito 散度，去掉它使 METR-LA 60 分钟 MAE 上升 0.30。统一评测下，60 分钟 MAE 为 METR-LA 3.098±0.017、PEMS-BAY 1.576±0.006，后者为十二个已发表基线中最低。

arxiv.title: Can AI Do Formal Demography? Why Vaccinating the Oldest Saves Both the Most Lives and the Most Years of Life
arxiv.abstract: Can AI contribute to formal demography? We report an experiment in which an AI model, Claude, was asked to explain and then simplify the proof of an earlier result: that vaccinating the oldest against COVID-19 saves both the most lives and the most years of life, because the years saved per person treated rise with age. The model proposed a new proof that is shorter, more intuitive, and somewhat more general than the original, built from a known life-table identity and the definition of convexity. It states the condition for the result as the convexity of the reciprocal of the hazard, which can be checked from the hazard alone and holds for most familiar parametric models, and it yields a lower bound on life expectancy whenever that condition is met. Prompted by a further question, the model also gave an exact form of the condition, showing how far convexity can be relaxed. The model traced these identities and related results in earlier literature. An edited record of the sessions is provided, and complete transcripts are available on request. The exercise suggests that AI can revisit established results, make them easier to understand, and prove valuable generalizations.
arxiv.titleZh: AI 能做形式人口学吗？为什么优先为最年长者接种疫苗能同时挽救最多生命与最多寿命年
arxiv.summaryZh: 围绕「AI 能否参与形式人口学」这一问题，以 COVID-19 疫苗接种优先序的既有结论为对象，要求 Claude 解释并简化「优先为最年长者接种可同时最大化挽救生命数与寿命年数」的证明。模型基于已知生命表恒等式与凸性定义，给出更短、更直观且更一般的新证明:把结论成立的条件表述为风险率倒数的凸性，该条件仅凭风险率即可检验、对多数常见参数模型成立，并在满足时给出预期寿命的下界;进一步追问下还给出可放松凸性的精确条件形式，并在既有文献中追溯相关恒等式与结果。作为单案例实验，显示 AI 可重访既有数学结论、降低理解门槛并给出有价值的推广。

arxiv.title: Online Label-Free Gradient Matching for Continual Language Model Training
arxiv.abstract: Language models in customer-facing products must be continually updated, since the data they serve shifts over time. As retraining on the full accumulated data is impractical, each update should instead run on a small set of examples carrying the training signal of all data seen so far. The strongest current methods build this set by gradient matching, which synthesizes examples whose training gradients match those of the full data. However, they require ground-truth labels, run once on a fixed snapshot rather than on a growing stream, and are slow on large data. We introduce \textbf{OLGA}, which lifts these limitations. It distills unlabeled data by drawing the gradient matching targets from the model's own next-token predictions. Across five text classification benchmarks with phi-1.5, it improves accuracy by 10 percentage points over the strongest selection baseline using as few as five examples. OLGA also distills online data streams by keeping a running rehearsal memory of synthetic examples, which is re-distilled together with each new batch as it arrives. In the online setting, it outperforms the strongest selection-based continual baseline by 6.6 stream-AUC percentage points. Finally, our method scales to large data by pairing distillation with selection in a hybrid pipeline, letting selection handle the mild stage of compression and distillation the extreme one. It cuts runtime by 30\% versus distillation alone at similar accuracy, and beats the best selection-only pipeline by up to 12.6 percentage points.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向持续语言模型训练的在线无标签梯度匹配
arxiv.summaryZh: 持续更新语言模型时无法反复全量重训，需用少量样本承载全部数据的训练信号;现有梯度匹配方法依赖真实标签、只在固定快照上离线运行一次，且在大数据上很慢。OLGA 把梯度匹配的目标梯度取自模型自身的下一 token 预测，从而在无标签数据上完成蒸馏，并维护一份合成样本的在线回放记忆，每来一批新数据就与记忆一起重新蒸馏。在 phi-1.5 上的五个文本分类基准中，仅用五个样本即比最强选择基线高 10 个百分点;在线流式设置下 stream-AUC 比最强选择式持续学习基线高 6.6 个百分点。方法还以「选择处理轻度压缩、蒸馏处理极端压缩」的混合流水线扩展到大数据，同等精度下比纯蒸馏减少 30% 运行时间，并比最佳纯选择流水线最高高 12.6 个百分点。

arxiv.title: A Hybrid Visitor Prediction Framework using Interpretable Temporal features, Integrating IQR and Anomaly Detection in Lakes in Nebraska
arxiv.abstract: For effective resource management, infrastructure planning, and sustainable tourism, it is really important to predict accurate visitors. This paper estimates the daily visitation of Nebraska lakes using spatial, basic temporal, and interpretable temporal features. Moreover, we evaluate the base models with multiple metrics. Using the best three models, our method will ensemble hybrid models and choose the best hybrid technique. Further, we investigate the impact of lag features and how the models work with different outlier detection techniques such as Interquartile Range (IQR) and anomaly detection. The models are evaluated using regression metrics (MAE, MSE, RMSE, MAPE, and R2). Experiment results show that, after removing anomalies, MAE, MSE, RMSE, and MAPE are reduced. Adding lag features also shows some positive effects on the results. Moreover, anomaly detection techniques perform better than IQR in improving performance while preserving data. The reported anomaly-based cross-validation results favored the voting ensemble over the compared base models on the evaluated metrics. In anomaly-based cross-validation, VOTE improved prediction errors compared with MLP (256,128,64); improvements varied in the single-split comparison. Specifically, the hybrid model reduced MAE by 9.82%, MSE by 3.12%, RMSE by 1.76%, and MAPE by 6.77%. In the reported cross-validation comparison, the best anomaly-based hybrid model had lower MAE, MSE, RMSE, and MAPE than the best IQR-based hybrid model by 9.81%, 34.30%, 18.99%, and 0.66%, respectively.
arxiv.titleZh: 使用可解释时间特征、融合 IQR 与异常检测的内布拉斯加州湖泊游客量混合预测框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向内布拉斯加州湖泊的日游客量预测，该工作以空间特征、基础时间特征与可解释时间特征为输入，先筛选表现最好的三个基模型再做混合集成，并比较 IQR 与异常检测两类离群点处理方式及滞后特征的影响。评测采用 MAE、MSE、RMSE、MAPE、R² 等回归指标。结果显示，剔除异常点后各项误差普遍下降，异常检测在保留数据的同时优于 IQR;基于异常检测的交叉验证中，voting 集成优于各基模型，相对 MLP(256,128,64)把 MAE 降低 9.82%、MAPE 降低 6.77%。该框架服务于旅游资源管理与基础设施规划场景，属传统机器学习在垂直领域的应用，与 LLM 方向无交集。

arxiv.title: Tilted Convexity and an Exact Offline-Online Separation
arxiv.abstract: Convexity has three equivalent descriptions: support by affine functions, monotonicity of the subdifferential, and increasing secant slopes. We weaken all three by one distortion with parameter $γ\in(0,1]$, which multiplies positive changes by $γ$ and divides negative ones by $γ$. The resulting classes are the convex functions at $γ=1$ and, for $γ<1$, are distinct and nested, with the parameter dropping by at most a square along the chain. For proper lower semicontinuous functions in these classes, the effective domain is convex, local minimizers are global, and the function is locally Lipschitz on the relative interior of its domain. The classes separate offline from online optimization over compact convex sets with efficient projection, with access to function values and bounded support vectors. A smooth member of any class can be minimized to additive accuracy $\varepsilon$ with $\mathrm{poly}(1/\varepsilon)$ first-order queries and projections. Online, with nonpositive losses and $α$-regret measured against $α$ times the best fixed point, a polynomial-time algorithm achieves $γ$-regret $O(\sqrt T)$ on the largest class. For every fixed, effectively specified $γ\in(0,1)$ and every $α\in(γ,1]$, no randomized polynomial-time algorithm has sublinear expected $α$-regret unless $\mathbf{NP}=\mathbf{RP}$, already for smooth concave polynomial losses in the smallest class, each minimized by one linear optimization. Thus, unless $\mathbf{NP}=\mathbf{RP}$, $γ$ is the exact online coefficient of each class, while the offline coefficient is one.
arxiv.titleZh: 倾斜凸性与精确的离线—在线分离
arxiv.summaryZh: 用参数γ统一扭曲凸性的三种等价刻画（仿射支撑、次微分单调、割线斜率），得到γ=1为凸函数、γ<1时互异且嵌套的函数类。该类保持有效域凸、局部极小即全局与局部Lipschitz；光滑成员可用poly(1/ε)次一阶查询和投影优化到ε精度。在线优化中最大类有O(√T)的γ-regret多项式算法，而除非NP=RP，任何γ<1与α∈(γ,1]下最小类也不存在亚线性α-regret的随机多项式算法，给出离线系数为1、在线系数恰为γ的精确分离。
arxiv.reason: 纯凸优化理论，与LLM后训练/Agent无关

arxiv.title: Unrolled gradients in disguise: bridging interpolation-based and Jacobian regularization for stable neural dynamics
arxiv.abstract: Hybrid models and neural differential equations (NDEs) are becoming increasingly important for modelling physical systems; however, they often encounter stability and accuracy issues during long-term integration. Training on unrolled trajectories is known to limit these divergences but quickly becomes too computationally expensive due to the need to compute gradients over an iterative process, making this method impractical for large-scale physical systems (e.g. weather and climate forecasting). Two popular paradigms for improving the stability of learned dynamics are to train on interpolated or noisy samples or to regularize the Jacobian of the learned representation. In this work, we demonstrate that these paradigms can be understood under a common lens and that they both correspond to an approximation of the gradients obtained in an unrolled learning strategy. Building on this understanding, we derive a principled and complete approach to regularize training and demonstrate its impact on the stability of learned dynamical systems.
arxiv.titleZh: 伪装下的展开梯度:连接基于插值与 Jacobian 正则化以实现稳定的神经动力学
arxiv.summaryZh: 神经微分方程与混合模型在长时积分中常出现不稳定与精度退化，按展开轨迹训练可抑制这种发散，但需对迭代过程反传梯度，开销过大，难以用于天气、气候等大规模物理系统;用插值或加噪样本训练、以及对学到的表示做 Jacobian 正则化，是两条常见的稳定化路线。该工作证明二者可在统一视角下理解，本质上都对应展开学习所得梯度的某种近似，并据此推导出一套完整且有理论依据的正则化训练方案，在学习到的动力系统上验证了其对稳定性的影响。结论适用于科学机器学习中的长期稳定建模。
arxiv.reason: 神经ODE稳定性与科学ML，与LLM关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Online Class Posteriors for Interpretable and Controllable Discrete Diffusion
arxiv.abstract: Discrete diffusion models remain far less understood than their continuous counterparts, despite recent breakthroughs across modalities, most notably in text. Leveraging tools from continuous diffusion, we formulate a theoretical framework to track the class-conditional posterior in an online manner by combining conditional and unconditional model predictions. In masked language modeling, this posterior offers highly interpretable dynamics: tokens aligned with a class boost the posterior, while contradictory ones suppress it. We also show that the posterior can be used for logical guidance operations (AND, OR, NOT) in discrete diffusion. These operations enable precise control over generation, such as avoiding specific classes. In addition, we discuss a mismatch in the formulation of classifier-free guidance between discrete and continuous settings: discrete models mix the data distributions, while continuous models mix the marginals. We validate our methods and discuss their potential applications on synthetic data, with all quantities analytically tractable, as well as on MNIST, text, and antibody sequences.
arxiv.comment: Preprint. Paper currently under review for ICLR 2027
arxiv.titleZh: 在线类后验：可解释、可控的离散扩散模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 离散扩散模型的理论理解远落后于连续扩散，尤其在文本生成上缺乏可解释的控制手段。该工作提出在线追踪类条件后验的理论框架，通过组合条件与无条件模型预测得到后验，并在掩码语言建模中呈现出可解释的动态：与目标类一致的 token 提升后验，矛盾的 token 抑制后验。基于该后验可实现 AND、OR、NOT 等逻辑引导操作，从而精确控制生成（如规避特定类别），并指出离散与连续设定下 classifier-free guidance 的错配：离散模型混合数据分布，连续模型混合边缘分布。方法在解析可算的合成数据及 MNIST、文本、抗体序列上验证。

arxiv.title: Improving Hamiltonian Learning through Local Energy Decomposition
arxiv.abstract: Hamiltonian neural networks provide a principled framework for learning conservative dynamics. A scalar Hamiltonian is parameterized by a neural network and the vector field is derived using Hamilton's equations. However, preserving Hamiltonian structure does not guarantee that the energy function itself is represented accurately. When modeled by a conventional multilayer perceptron, the Hamiltonian inherits the spectral bias of coordinate-based neural representations, favoring smooth over fine-scale structure. These fine-scale errors can be amplified by differentiation when computing the dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce Local Multiscale Hamiltonian Neural Network (LM-HNN), which restructures the Hamiltonian according to its physical interaction structure. LM-HNN decomposes the energy into kinetic and potential components and represents them as sums of shared local functions over multiple interaction neighborhoods. This replaces a single high-dimensional approximation problem with lower-dimensional, reusable interaction laws, making fine-scale energy structure easier to resolve while preserving Hamiltonian dynamics. Across low-dimensional, interacting, and fast--slow systems, LM-HNN consistently achieves more accurate Hamiltonian derivatives and long-horizon rollouts than competing structure-preserving models, while substantially extending the effective spectral range of the learned energy. The same structured representation also generalizes more reliably to energy levels not observed during training. These results show that accuracy depends on the Hamiltonian representation as well as its structure, and that incorporating locality, decomposition, and shared interaction laws provides a simple and effective route to more accurate and generalizable Hamiltonian learning.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过局部能量分解改进哈密顿量学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 哈密顿神经网络用神经网络参数化标量哈密顿量并由哈密顿方程导出向量场，但保持哈密顿结构并不能保证能量函数本身被准确表示:基于坐标的 MLP 存在谱偏置，偏向平滑结构，细尺度误差在微分求动力学时会被放大。LM-HNN 依据物理交互结构重构哈密顿量，将能量分解为动能与势能，并表示为多个交互邻域上共享局部函数之和，把单个高维逼近问题换成低维、可复用的交互律。在低维、相互作用与快慢系统中，其哈密顿导数精度与长时程 rollout 均优于其他保结构模型，并显著扩展所学能量的有效谱范围，对训练中未见的能级也有更好泛化。
arxiv.reason: 哈密顿神经网络属物理建模，与 LLM/Agent 方向无关

arxiv.title: Playing Dumb: How a Chess Transformer Simulates Users Across Skill Levels
arxiv.abstract: Generative models increasingly simulate users at different skill levels in education and AI evaluation. Yet it remains unclear whether lower-skill behavior reflects less internal knowledge or a different use of retained knowledge. This distinction is difficult to study in natural language, where proficiency and relevant knowledge are hard to measure. In this work, we study Maia-2, a chess transformer that predicts human moves conditioned on player skill, using quantitative skill ratings and deterministically labeled chess concepts. We hold board positions and model weights fixed and analyze positions where skill conditioning changes the prediction from a blunder to the best move. First, we measure encoded knowledge by training probes to predict the presence of 172 chess concepts from Maia-2's internal states. Probe accuracy remains nearly constant across skill conditions, and probes trained at one level transfer accurately to the others. To test whether stronger decisions can be recovered from this retained knowledge, we fine-tune only Maia-2's final output layer, raising best-move accuracy in the lowest skill band from 14.4% to 82.8%. Training this layer only on highest-skill representations retains most of the improvement at lower levels, showing that recovery does not require direct training on lower-skill states. Steering concept-relevant features learned by a sparse autoencoder also improves lower-skill decisions while leaving probe-measured concept encoding practically unchanged. These results support an account in which skill conditioning changes how retained concept knowledge influences move selection, showing that weaker behavior can understate the knowledge available within a model.
arxiv.titleZh: 装傻：一个国际象棋 Transformer 如何模拟不同水平的用户
arxiv.summaryZh: 低水平行为究竟反映内部知识更少，还是知识使用方式不同，在自然语言中难以度量，故以按棋手水平条件预测落子的 Maia-2 为对象研究。固定棋盘与权重，聚焦技能条件使预测由失误转为最佳着法的局面；用探针从内部状态预测 172 个棋类概念，准确率跨水平几乎不变且可迁移。仅微调最后一层输出层，最低水平组最佳着法准确率由 14.4% 升至 82.8%，仅用最高水平表征训练亦保留大部分增益；对稀疏自编码器概念特征做 steering 同样改善低水平决策而概念编码几乎不变。表明技能条件改变的是已有知识影响选着的方式，弱行为可能低估模型内部可用知识。

arxiv.title: Bridging Neural Tangent Kernel Analysis and Reinforcement Learning for Deep Function Approximation
arxiv.abstract: Despite their widespread success across machine learning, the learning dynamics and generalization properties of neural networks remain poorly understood. The neural tangent kernel (NTK) provides an analytical characterization of the learning dynamics of infinitely wide neural networks and serves as a useful proxy for finite-width networks in supervised learning. In this work, we extend the NTK framework to reinforcement learning (RL) by introducing a temporal-difference (TD) flow formulation that accommodates time-varying mini-batches and TD targets, yielding a closed-form solution for value function evolution in an overparametrized setting. We also devise an optimization-based state-space exploration method that leverages the closed-form solution, coupled with constraints on the environment, to model the set of feasible states. On a deterministic grid environment, we validate that the proposed RL-based NTK formulation is indeed learning efficiently and adapting to the distribution shift in the training data distribution, and we demonstrate that the resulting exploration strategy improves sample efficiency. To our knowledge, this is the first work to extend NTK theory to characterize the learning dynamics of RL training with time-varying mini-batches and TD updates.
arxiv.titleZh: 连接神经切线核分析与强化学习以实现深度函数逼近
arxiv.summaryZh: 神经网络在强化学习中的学习动力学与泛化仍缺乏解析刻画。该工作把NTK框架推广到RL，提出可处理时变小批量与TD目标的TD流表述，在过参数化设定下给出值函数演化的闭式解；并利用该闭式解与环境约束构造基于优化的状态空间探索方法，以建模可行状态集合。在确定性网格环境中验证了该RL-NTK表述能有效学习并适应训练数据分布漂移，探索策略提升样本效率；这也是首次用NTK刻画含时变小批量与TD更新的RL训练动力学。

arxiv.title: Optimize the Harness, Not the Model: Fitting a Minimal Agent to a Self-Hostable LLM for Investigative Analysis
arxiv.abstract: Government intelligence teams need LLM agents that can analyze large, messy evidence collections, but security and cost constraints often rule out hosted frontier models and broad, hard-to-audit tool surfaces. We report CLEO: Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization, a method for fitting a minimal agent harness to a fixed, self-hostable LLM. Given an expert-validated dataset, CLEO admits only the tools, guardrails, memory policies, and loop components that improve accuracy while remaining general and auditable. On our held-out dataset, the CLEO harness reaches an 83.8% pass rate, within 1.2 points of the strongest out-of-the-box Claude Code SDK baseline, while being two orders of magnitude smaller.

arxiv.titleZh: 优化 harness 而非模型:将最小 agent 适配到可自托管的 LLM，用于调查性分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 在政府情报分析场景中，证据集合庞大杂乱，而安全与成本约束排除了托管前沿模型和难以审计的宽工具面。为此提出 CLEO(Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization):面对固定的、可自托管的 LLM 与一份经专家校验的数据集，只保留那些能提升准确率、同时保持通用与可审计的工具、护栏、记忆策略与循环组件，从而把 agent harness 压缩到最小。在留出集上，CLEO harness 的通过率为 83.8%，与最强的开箱 Claude Code SDK 基线相差 1.2 个百分点，而体量小两个数量级。

arxiv.title: A Living Leaderboard for Graph Machine Learning
arxiv.abstract: Graph machine learning benchmarking results are scattered across papers that use quite different sets of datasets and baseline methods, making it difficult to tell whether a reported gain reflects architectural progress or merely an outdated comparison or weakly tuned baseline. We introduce a living, graph-learning-specific leaderboard that organizes reported results by dataset, putting new results into context. As of 15 October 2026 our LLM-based extraction pipeline extracted 27,723 eligible results across 111 datasets from 885 peer-reviewed papers. Our analysis of these results quantifies concerns about graph-learning benchmarking: legacy datasets are still actively used and many result tables contain baseline results that are drastically lower than those already available in the literature, e.g. 45% Amazon-ratings tables and 37% for Peptides-struct. The leaderboard allows to quickly compare new results against compatible prior results, aiming to improve the overall quality of graph learning benchmarking.
arxiv.comment: The leaderboard is available at https://graphlearningbenchmarks.github.io , the code at https://github.com/martinalex000/benchmarking_website
arxiv.titleZh: 面向图机器学习的活体排行榜
arxiv.summaryZh: 图机器学习的结果分散在数据集与基线设置各异的论文里，难以判断涨点来自架构进步还是过时对比。为此构建按数据集组织的活体排行榜，用基于 LLM 的抽取流水线从 885 篇同行评审论文中抽取 111 个数据集上的 27,723 条可用结果，把新结果放回历史语境。分析显示旧数据集仍在被大量使用，且不少结果表的基线远低于文献已有水平，例如 Amazon-ratings 有 45%、Peptides-struct 有 37% 的表格存在此问题。该榜单可用于快速核对新结果与可比历史结果，面向图学习社区改善评测规范。

arxiv.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
arxiv.abstract: Research taste, the judgment of what to read, which problems to pursue, and which methods to try, increasingly shapes the work of AI scientists, yet it remains far less understood than their ability to execute research. We introduce IdeaTaste, a benchmark that scores an LLM by how closely the research proposals it writes from a literature snapshot frozen at 2025 match the work the same communities published in 2026. Our experiments span six contemporary language models and four research areas from established to emerging fields, covering more than 90{,}000 proposals in total. LLM agents fall well short of human communities in both the literature they cite and the ideas they state, reaching about 26\% of the human level on citation matching and only 18\% on idea matching. Their populations can cite as diversely as a community and take up its tasks and methods, yet rarely arrive at the concrete approaches and research plans it pursues. Neither richer field context nor larger populations substantially close this gap. In blinded expert review, AI proposals trail the 2026 papers least in presentation and most in expected success, echoing their gap in concrete approaches, and those whose ideas no human paper shares fare worst, suggesting weaker directions rather than overlooked opportunities. These results indicate that the main bottleneck in AI research taste lies less in finding the directions a community works on than in turning them into the concrete approaches it goes on to pursue. We release IdeaTaste as an open, continuously updated leaderboard (https://cxcscmu.github.io/IdeaTaste) that benchmarks contemporary AI proposals against future publication cycles.
arxiv.titleZh: IdeaTaste：LLM 是否具备人类研究者的科研品味？
arxiv.summaryZh: 评估 AI 科学家的「科研品味」，即判断该读什么、该追什么难题、该试什么方法的能力。IdeaTaste 以 2025 年冻结的文献快照为输入，让 LLM 撰写研究提案，再与同一社区 2026 年实际发表的论文比对打分，覆盖 6 个语言模型、4 个研究领域、逾 9 万份提案，并辅以盲审专家评审。结果显示，引用匹配仅约达人类的 26%，想法匹配约 18%：模型群体的引用多样性与任务、方法覆盖可接近社区水平，却很少落到社区实际采用的具体方案，更丰富的领域上下文与更大群体规模均未显著缩小差距。专家评审中，AI 提案在预期成功率上落后最多，且无人类论文与其想法重合的提案表现最差，说明瓶颈不在找方向，而在把方向转化为具体方法。
arxiv.reason: AI for Research 基准，9 万份提案对照未来论文，分量扎实

arxiv.title: Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Clinical Time-Series Models
arxiv.abstract: Deep learning models for electronic health records achieve strong predictive performance but provide little insight into what clinical concepts they represent internally. Post-hoc attribution methods produce per-cell importance scores that lack temporal coherence, cross-variable structure, and reusability across patients. We introduce the Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoder (TI-SAE), which learns a backbone-specific, patient-shared clinical concept dictionary from a frozen predictive model's representations. Each dictionary entry (latent) is defined by learned temporal Gaussian islands (specifying when the concept is active) and a sparse variable-composition vector (specifying which variables are involved). A decoupled selector then identifies which dictionary entries drive each patient's prediction, separating representation learning from attribution. We evaluate TI-SAE across five backbone architectures spanning different representation strategies on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV (three prediction tasks each). TI-SAE produces structured clinical concepts that go beyond transient attribution heatmaps while achieving strong performance on standard faithfulness benchmarks.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向临床时间序列模型可解释性的时间岛稀疏自编码器
arxiv.summaryZh: 电子健康记录深度学习模型预测性能强但内部临床概念不透明，事后归因方法逐单元打分，缺乏时间连贯性、跨变量结构和跨患者复用性。TI-SAE 从冻结预测模型的表示中学习骨干特定、患者共享的临床概念字典，每个潜变量由可学习的时间高斯岛（概念激活时段）与稀疏变量组成向量（涉及哪些变量）定义，再用解耦选择器识别驱动每位患者预测的字典条目，将表示学习与归因分离。在 MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 上跨五种表示策略不同的骨干架构、各三个预测任务评估，TI-SAE 产出超越瞬时归因热图的结构化临床概念，并在标准忠实性基准上保持强劲表现。
arxiv.reason: 可解释性方法有方法学趣味，但属临床垂直应用，偏离主线

arxiv.title: Finite-Memory Control of POMDPs: Fundamental Limits and Efficient Design
arxiv.abstract: Optimal control of partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs), in general, requires a complete history. The belief state, a distribution over hidden states, summarizes this history and provides the classical sufficient statistic to control POMDPs. However, the continuous nature of the belief space generally prevents a finite-memory controller from maintaining it exactly. This raises the question we address in this work: what must the available finite memory preserve to achieve near-optimal control performance? We study this question through an information-theoretic converse that gives a fundamental lower bound on the loss of any finite-memory controller. The analysis introduces the concept of a decision witness that characterizes belief states whose confusion would lead to unavoidable loss. Motivated by this bound, we propose RECAP, a constructive quantization method for designing representative memory states. We prove an upper bound on the optimality gap of any RECAP codebook and use the components of this bound together with the converse analysis to define the codebook objective. Experiments on 11 POMDP benchmarks demonstrate that RECAP improves over finite-memory representation baselines under the same memory budget.
arxiv.titleZh: POMDP 的有限记忆控制：根本极限与高效设计
arxiv.summaryZh: POMDP 的最优控制通常需要完整历史，信念状态虽为经典充分统计量，但其连续取值使有限记忆控制器难以精确维护。该工作用信息论逆定理给出任意有限记忆控制器损失的根本下界，并提出 decision witness 概念，刻画一旦混淆就必然带来损失的信念状态。由此提出构造性量化方法 RECAP，为码本最优性差距证明上界，并用该上界的各组成部分定义码本目标。在 11 个 POMDP 基准上，相同记忆预算下 RECAP 优于有限记忆表示基线。
arxiv.reason: POMDP 有限记忆控制理论，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向无关

arxiv.title: DeliverBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Delivering Realistic Multi-Stage Professional Projects
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents are judged by what they deliver, and in professional work what gets delivered is a project, not a task. A project pays off only if the whole package holds, and one weak part can limit the value of the rest. Yet existing benchmarks mostly test agents on one task at a time, leaving a gap between the capability we measure and the outcome that makes agents useful. To address this gap, we introduce DeliverBench, which tests whether agents can carry a project from brief to final delivery. Its 11 projects, spanning financial due diligence, legal contract drafting, and drug safety reporting, are reconstructed with 13 domain experts from real materials and chain 150 subtasks through 2-15 rounds of new materials and client feedback. Because no reference outputs are injected, agents inherit their own errors from one task to the next. Expert rubrics then score every checkpoint as well as the final package. Across seven model-harness systems, even the best system scores only 65.0 out of 100 on final delivery and passes 50.0% of subtasks at a 90-point threshold. The failures are often failures of carrying work forward: in one audit project, all seven systems addressed the review findings, but only one preserved traceability. Together, these results suggest that task-level capability does not simply compose into delivery, which also depends on keeping the work coherent as it evolves.
arxiv.titleZh: DeliverBench：评测 AI Agent 交付真实多阶段专业项目的能力
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有基准多以单任务方式考察 Agent，难以反映专业工作中「交付整个项目」的实际要求。DeliverBench 与 13 位领域专家基于真实材料重建 11 个项目（财务尽调、合同起草、药物安全报告），把 150 个子任务用 2–15 轮新资料与客户反馈串联；评测不注入参考输出，Agent 的错误会逐级累积；专家评分标准同时评估各检查点与最终交付包。七个模型-harness 系统中最佳者最终交付仅 65.0/100，子任务在 90 分阈值下通过率为 50.0%；某审计项目中七个系统都处理了评审意见，却只有一个保留可追溯性。这说明任务级能力不会自然合成为交付能力，长程一致性的维持是关键瓶颈。
arxiv.reason: 面向长程项目交付的 Agent 评测基准，命中 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Low-Rank Clebsch--Gordan Coupling for Equivariant Spherical Forecasting
arxiv.abstract: Spherical-harmonic neural operators provide an efficient representation for global forecasting, but their discretized pointwise nonlinearities can break rotational equivariance through aliasing. Clebsch-Gordan (CG) tensor products provide exactly equivariant interactions between spherical-harmonic representations, but their computational cost grows rapidly with spectral bandwidth and has limited their use at forecasting scale. We introduce LCG-SFNO, which combines low-rank CG interactions within a controlled low-degree band with coefficient-space residual propagation and an exactly projected quadratic nonlinearity, preserving SO(3) equivariance throughout the learned operator. To make the CG interaction practical, we further develop SSHCG, a sparse GPU implementation with a factorized alternative for wider coupled bands. On spherical shallow-water dynamics and the ERA5-based WeatherBench benchmark, LCG-SFNO reduces rotational error to numerical precision (more than three orders of magnitude below SFNO on shallow water and five orders of magnitude below it on WeatherBench), while matching SFNO on shallow-water forecasting and substantially improving forecast skill relative to SFNO on WeatherBench. Matched ablations show that CG coupling accelerates convergence, while SSHCG keeps the coupling to about 10 percent of a training step at the operating bandwidth, making exact equivariant coupling practical at forecasting scale.
arxiv.titleZh: 低秩 Clebsch-Gordan 耦合的等变球面预报
arxiv.summaryZh: 球谐神经算子在全局预报中效率很高，但逐点非线性在离散化后会产生混叠，破坏旋转等变性。Clebsch-Gordan(CG)张量积能给出严格等变的球谐交互，但计算量随谱带宽迅速增长，难以用于预报规模。LCG-SFNO 在受控的低阶带宽内做低秩 CG 耦合，配合系数空间残差传播与严格投影的二次非线性，使整个学习到的算子保持 SO(3) 等变;并给出稀疏 GPU 实现 SSHCG 及其因式分解变体以支持更宽带耦合。在球面浅水方程与基于 ERA5 的 WeatherBench 上，旋转误差降至数值精度(浅水低于 SFNO 三个数量级以上，WeatherBench 低五个数量级)，浅水预报与 SFNO 持平，WeatherBench 预报技巧显著提升，CG 耦合开销约为单步训练的 10%。
arxiv.reason: 球面等变神经算子用于气象预报，仅在等变架构与 GPU 效率层面与关注方向擦边

arxiv.title: LAND: Learning an Adaptive Number of Draws for Bayesian Best-of-N Selection
arxiv.abstract: Best-of-N decoding improves generation quality by sampling multiple candidates and selecting the best, but it allocates equal compute to sources regardless of how much they benefit from additional sampling: the expected benefit is small for sources with low-variance score distributions and potentially much larger for those with high-variance distributions. To address this shortcoming, we propose LAND (Learning an Adaptive Number of Draws), which dynamically allocates samples according to their posterior-predictive marginal value. LAND learns a discrete empirical mixture of source-conditioned score distributions from calibration data, updates its belief about a source as completion scores are observed, and stops sampling when the expected improvement of another draw falls below a shared compute price. Across machine-translation experiments with multiple models and language pairs, LAND achieves better MetricX scores than fixed best-of-N at matched average compute. Conversely, at matched translation quality, LAND requires approximately 20-40% fewer candidate generations. Adaptive allocation therefore provides a simple way to retain the benefits of best-of-N while substantially improving its compute efficiency.
arxiv.comment: 10 pages. Published in Proceedings of the Eleventh Conference on Machine Translation (WMT 2026)
arxiv.titleZh: LAND：为贝叶斯最佳 N 采样学习自适应抽样次数
arxiv.summaryZh: 最佳 N 解码对每个输入固定采样候选数，无法按收益分配算力：低方差来源多加采样几乎无用，高方差来源则收益显著。LAND 将来源条件分数分布建模为离散经验混合，用校准数据学习后验预测边际价值，观测到补全分数后更新信念，当再一次采样的期望提升低于统一算力价格时停止。机器翻译实验中，多模型与多语言对上 LAND 在同等平均算力下 MetricX 优于固定最佳 N，同等翻译质量下候选生成量减少约 20%–40%。这一自适应分配思路可推广到其他可验证评分的采样选择场景。
arxiv.reason: 自适应采样分配结合贝叶斯决策，属推理算力效率方向，机器翻译应用略偏垂直

arxiv.title: Can We Stop the Backtest Yet? Anytime-Valid Promotion Tests for Adaptive Financial Research Agents
arxiv.abstract: Financial research agents can generate and monitor trading rules faster than a human can document the resulting selection process. Candidates appear at data-dependent times, weak rules are abandoned, and promising ones are watched until they cross a reporting threshold. We introduce PROMOTE, a protocol that assigns every candidate predictable testing wealth at birth and accumulates a cost-aware e-process only from subsequent returns. If lifetime allocations sum to at most one, a weighted Ville argument bounds the probability of ever promoting a rule whose declared bounded net score has always had nonpositive conditional mean. The result permits dependent candidates, adaptive births, and indefinite monitoring. We audit the implementation in two settings. A retrospective pseudo-out-of-sample replay contains 24 panel--rule hypotheses, 3,000 shared-sign null paths, injected alternatives, and public ETF and industry data. Repeated unadjusted tests produce a family crossing in 94.5% of null paths, versus 0.0% for PROMOTE; at a 15-bp aligned ETF-component perturbation, PROMOTE has 70.1% target power and median crossing session 2,327. A separate exact mean-zero experiment lets an agent select candidate identities and birth times from past scores; the funded gate has 1.77% false-family crossings across 3,000 programs. The market replay produces zero promotions after costs. The certificate controls historical false promotion under the declared null; it is not a certificate that an earlier edge remains profitable at deployment. AI-use disclosure. Generative AI tools, including OpenAI Codex, assisted manuscript preparation. For this preprint version, Codex assisted with LaTeX editing, author and venue metadata, compilation, and layout checks.
arxiv.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at ICAIF 2026, Milan, Italy
arxiv.titleZh: 能否停止回测？面向自适应金融研究 Agent 的随时有效提升检验
arxiv.summaryZh: 金融研究 Agent 生成与监控交易规则的速度远超人工记录其选择过程：候选出现时刻依赖数据，弱规则被弃，有希望的规则被持续监视到跨过报告阈值，使多重检验与自适应选择难以约束。PROMOTE 在候选诞生时为其分配可预测的检验财富，仅用后续收益累积带成本的 e-process；当终身配额之和不超过 1 时，加权 Ville 论证可界定「声明有界净分且条件均值始终非正」的规则被提升的概率，并允许候选相关、自适应出生与无限期监控。含 24 个面板—规则假设与 3000 条零路径的回放中，未校正重复检验的族错误率 94.5%，PROMOTE 为 0.0%，15bp 扰动下功效 70.1%、中位跨越于第 2327 个交易日；市场回放计入成本后零提升。
arxiv.reason: 金融 Agent 的 anytime-valid 检验，方法学有趣但偏垂直应用
